title: Python Developer
description:
Python GCP Developer


Language: Portuguese & English

Position: Remote

Experience: Mid to Senior


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement serverless cloud solutions using GCP Cloud Functions;
  • Design data models and manage largescale data storage with GCP Bigtable;
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to cloud functions and associated services;
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate deployment and monitoring of cloud functions;
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance cloud infrastructure and application performance;
  • Mentor and support team members in adopting best practices for Python and GCP development;
  • Document technical designs processes and best practices for knowledge sharing;
  • Engage with stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions;
  • Ensure adherence to security best practices in cloud deployments;
  • Stay updated with the latest GCP advancements and industry trends.


Mandatory Knowledge

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent work experience;
  • 5 to 7 years of experience in development;
  • Proficiency in Python, GCP Bigtable and GCP Cloud Functions;
  • Hands on experience with designing data models, developing and automation and deployment of cloud functions.



Does this sounds like something you'd like to do?

title: Analista de dados de marketing
description:
Localização: Remoto

Tipo de contratação: Tempo integral

Contrato: A combinar


Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados de Marketing para apoiar a análise e interpretação de dados relacionados às estratégias de marketing digital. O profissional será responsável por acompanhar métricas, identificar padrões de desempenho e gerar insights que contribuam para a melhoria contínua das campanhas e iniciativas de marketing.


Responsabilidades

Coletar, organizar e analisar dados provenientes de campanhas e canais de marketing digital.

Monitorar indicadores de desempenho e métricas relevantes (KPIs).

Criar relatórios e dashboards para acompanhamento de resultados.

Identificar tendências e oportunidades de otimização baseadas em dados.

Apoiar equipes de marketing com análises e recomendações estratégicas.

Garantir a qualidade e consistência das informações analisadas.


Requisitos

Experiência com análise de dados, marketing digital ou áreas relacionadas.

Conhecimento em ferramentas de análise de dados e relatórios.

Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados.

Capacidade de interpretar dados e transformá-los em insights úteis.

Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe.


Benefícios

Remuneração compatível com o mercado.

Ambiente de trabalho profissional e colaborativo.

Oportunidades de desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional.

title: Data Engineer (Apache NIFI) Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Senior profile (minimum 5 years of professional experience)
  • Very strong data transformation skills , with proven hands-on experience in complex transformation scenarios.
  • Solid knowledge of XML , including advanced usage of XPath for data extraction, manipulation, and validation.
  • At least 2 years of eperience with Apache NIFI.
  • Good understanding of data integration concepts and flow-based programming.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
  • Fluent English
  • Williness to move to Portugal



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hibryd


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV to: .

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Analytics Manager
description:
Senior Operations Data Analyst

100% Remote (Brazil-Based) | US-Based Company | Paid in USD/hour


We are hiring for a leading US-based luxury resale and eCommerce company transforming how high-end fashion is bought and sold globally.


We are looking for a Senior Operations Data Analyst with a strong analytics mindset, solid SQL expertise, and proven experience working closely with business teams. This is a high-impact role focused on operational performance, business clarity, and strategic decision-making.


About the Role


You will deliver quantitative insights to support our Operations organization, partnering closely with teams across:


  • Inventory
  • Logistics
  • Retail
  • Customer Service
  • Tech & Finance


This is a business-focused analytics role, not pure research or advanced modeling. The day-to-day work includes:


  • Explaining performance changes (“why did this move?”)
  • Turning open-ended business questions into structured analysis
  • Designing and defining KPIs
  • Measuring operational efficiency across receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows
  • Translating business needs into technical solutions

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: CUA Trajectory Specialist - 65129
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical business problems.


Role Overview:

We are looking for skilled professionals to contribute as S2 Annotators , responsible for producing and validating high-quality Computer-Use Agent (CUA) trajectories for developer-adjacent workflows. This includes tasks such as file operations, light scripting, API interactions, and browser automation.

This role requires a strong understanding of technical workflows, attention to detail, and the ability to translate natural language instructions into precise, step-by-step executable actions that can be used to train advanced AI systems.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Create detailed, step-by-step positive CUA trajectories for technical tasks (e.g., file manipulation, scripting, API calls, browser-based workflows)
  • Break down natural language instructions into clear, verifiable actions
  • Validate and review trajectories for correctness, completeness, and reproducibility
  • Work within Linux desktop environments to execute and document workflows
  • Use scripting (Python/Bash) to simulate or validate task execution where required
  • Interact with tools and environments involving APIs, terminals, and browser automation
  • Collaborate with internal teams to refine task quality and annotation guidelines
  • Ensure consistency, accuracy, and high-quality standards across all annotations


Requirements:

  • 2–5 years of experience in software development, technical support, or similar technical roles
  • Strong familiarity with Linux environments and command-line operations
  • Proficiency in at least one scripting language: Python or Bash
  • Ability to decompose complex instructions into structured, step-by-step workflows
  • Strong attention to detail in documenting technical processes
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows
  • Basic understanding of APIs, file systems, and developer tooling
  • Familiarity with OpenClaw or similar environments/tools


Nice to Have:

  • Prior experience in data annotation, RLHF, or SFT labeling workflows
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, REST APIs, or terminal-based automation
  • Experience working with browser automation tools or developer productivity tools
  • Background in evaluating or improving AI-generated outputs


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work with cutting-edge AI technology and contribute to next-generation systems
  • Flexible, remote work environment
  • Opportunity to collaborate with leading AI researchers and engineers
  • Competitive compensation based on your expertise
  • Long-term engagement opportunities


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 20 hours per week, with a 4-hour overlap with PST.
  • Employment Type: Contractor position (Note: this role does not include medical/paid leave).
  • Duration of Contract: 5 weeks; (expected start date is next week).
  • Location: Remote (India, Brazil, Mexico, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Egypt, Nigeria, Ghana, Turkey)


Evaluation Process:

  • Resume screening
  • Take home assessment (60 mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

  • Experiência com modelagem de cenários para tomada de decisão;

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.

Essential Skills


  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Java Specialist
description:
Job Title: Java Specialist – Spring

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Contract

Role Summary


We are looking for a Java Specialist – Spring with strong backend development experience to build and maintain scalable applications using modern Java technologies.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop applications using Java (8+) , Spring (Boot/MVC) , and Hibernate
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and web services
  • Work with relational databases (Oracle, MySQL)
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Use tools like Git, Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow

Required Skills

  • Strong Java & Spring Framework experience
  • Good understanding of OOP concepts
  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs
  • Experience with SQL databases
  • Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React
  • Strong problem-solving and communication skills

title: Account Manager
description:
THIS ROLE REQUIRES RELOCATING TO TAIWAN FOR 6 MONTHS FOR MANDATORY TRAINING


Main Responsibilities:


  • Develop long-term relationships with key customers, ensuring consistent engagement and satisfaction
  • Oversee and expand revenue streams within an assigned portfolio by identifying growth opportunities
  • Collaborate with clients to improve game visibility and performance through targeted marketing and promotional activities
  • Contribute to securing and maintaining favorable commercial terms in partnerships
  • Coordinate closely with internal marketing teams to deliver high-quality and effective promotional campaigns
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to clients by sharing insights, best practices, and industry knowledge
  • Provide prompt and efficient support to operators, ensuring all requests are handled in a timely manner


Desired experience:


  • Previous experience in account management, business development, or similar client-facing roles, ideally within iGaming, gaming, or digital entertainment (preferred but not strictly mandatory)
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build lasting relationships
  • Familiarity with marketing strategies and promotional planning is advantageous
  • Good organizational skills and ability to manage multiple accounts simultaneously
  • Brazilian nationality or eligibility to work in Brazil is required
  • Willingness to undergo an initial training period in Taiwan before transitioning to a role based in Brazil (mandatory)

title: Profissional Cientista de Dados
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Estamos buscando um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Inteligência Artificial, com foco no desenvolvimento de agentes corporativos baseados em LLMs .

Buscamos profissional com:

✔️ +5 anos em Ciência de Dados / Machine Learning

✔️ Experiência prática com IA Generativa e LLMs

✔️ Arquitetura RAG (embeddings, bancos vetoriais, retrieval)

✔️ Construção de agentes (ReAct / tool calling)

✔️ Prompt engineering e mitigação de hallucinations

✔️ Python, NLP, APIs REST, SQL

✔️ Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Estamos buscando um(a) Cientista de Dados Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de Inteligência Artificial, com foco no desenvolvimento de agentes corporativos baseados em LLMs .

Buscamos profissional com:

✔️ +5 anos em Ciência de Dados / Machine Learning

✔️ Experiência prática com IA Generativa e LLMs

✔️ Arquitetura RAG (embeddings, bancos vetoriais, retrieval)

✔️ Construção de agentes (ReAct / tool calling)

✔️ Prompt engineering e mitigação de hallucinations

✔️ Python, NLP, APIs REST, SQL

✔️ Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Consultor Funcional SAP, Testes, Negócios
description:
CHAMADA ÚNICA – BOOTCAMP SAP CCS|PROGRAMA DE CAPACITAÇÃO


Não perca a oportunidade de fazer parte de um Programa de Capacitação exclusivo para um processo de seleção do BOOTCAMP SAP CCS - Customer Care & Service.

Confira abaixo os detalhes e requisitos mínimos para a sua inscrição:


O que é SAP CCS?

O CCS é a solução da SAP voltada para gestão do ciclo de relacionamento com clientes, muito usada em empresas de Utilities (energia, água, gás, telecom). Ele cobre todo o ciclo de atendimento: do primeiro contato do cliente até faturamento, cobrança e serviços técnicos em campo.


O que é o Bootcamp?

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Requisitos mínimos para participar:

Ter, no mínimo, 3 anos de experiência profissional como:

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Analista de TI com experiência em aplicações similares ao SAP CCS no atendimento às empresas de utilities.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Contract Account: gestão da conta (débitos, créditos, faturas e pagamentos etc) e do contrato com o cliente (Tarifas, datas, status do serviço etc).

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Sistemas de Informação em Utilities: uso de SAP CCS ou ERPs similares ou custom para empresas do segmento.


Vantagens de participar:

Crescente demanda com a migração para o SAP S/4HANA em empresas de Utilities

Crescimento profissional acelerado e remuneração competitiva

Programa 100% gratuito para os comprometidos

Possibilidade de contratação pela Etho ou parceiros ao final do treinamento


Informações importantes:


Duração: 8 semanas consecutivas, 3 dias por semana: às 2af, 3af, e 5af.

3 horas por sessão, período noturno.


Idioma: não é requerido, mas se tiver aumentam suas chances de participação


Etapas do processo: Triagem|Teste de Raciocínio Lógico|Entrevistas RH e Técnicas


Localização: residir em qualquer lugar do Brasil, preferencialmente para a região de SP, RJ e BH.


Participação: Formação Custeada Integralmente


Se você atende aos requisitos mínimos, envie seu currículo para:

Assunto do e-mail:(Bootcamp SAP CCS)


Vagas limitadas! Não perca essa oportunidade única de transformar sua carreira!

Ative para ver a imagem maior.

title: Agente de viagens
description:
Descrição do Cargo Estamos em busca de um Agente de Viagens para integrar nossa equipe na 4WAY Travel.


  • Operadora & Agência de Viagem com mais de 20 anos de mercado nos mesmos locais


  • Localizada nos melhores shoppings de São Paulo.


  • Atividades diárias incluirão: Elaboração de pacotes turísticos, atendimento a clientes buscando entender suas necessidades, reservas de passagens e hospedagens, além de acompanhamento de cotações e negociações com fornecedores.


  • Este é um cargo de tempo integral, presencial e com escalas 6X1 que inclui os finais de semana.


Qualificações


  • Serviços de Viagem: Experiência em montagem de roteiros, reservas de voos, hotéis e transporte, e atendimento ao cliente no setor de turismo.
  • Habilidades de Comunicação: Capacidade de se comunicar claramente, negociar com clientes e prestar um atendimento personalizado presencialmente e de forma remoto.
  • Organização e Planejamento: Proatividade, atenção aos detalhes e habilidades organizacionais para gerenciar múltiplas solicitações simultaneamente.
  • Necessario experiência prévia em agências de viagem ou operadoras turísticas e conhecimento em ferramentas de reservas e emissão de passagens e pacotes.

description:
️ Procuro Representantes Comerciais para Projeto Imobiliário em Balneário Camboriú

Se você tem uma rede de contatos com empresários, médicos, agropecuaristas ou investidores com capital para alocar — quero conversar com você.

Ganhos a partir de R$ 3.000 para você.

Não precisa de experiência em finanças. Precisa ter relacionamento com pessoas investidoras.

Se você é corretor de alto padrão, assessor, empresário com rede sólida ou simplesmente conhece as pessoas certas — me chama no privado.

Envie mensagem com \"CAMBORIÚ\" para eu te passar os detalhes.

Vagas limitadas — trabalho com poucos parceiros, mas os certos.

title: Online English Teacher
description:
Online English Teacher (Remote)


If you are passionate about teaching and love to see students improve quickly, you are perfect for this role.


Create English is the online arm of LivEnglish — the renowned in-person immersion and the fastest-growing intensive language program for business executives.


The Method


The method is unique and unprecedented, being the only constructivist approach to language teaching.

We do not use lesson materials or course books. You will learn how to extract content from students and help them master it.


Our method encourages the use of Portuguese and translations in order to allow for authentic real-life practice.


The Ideal Teacher


We are seeking English teachers who are fluent in English and have a good command of Portuguese .

This professional will be responsible for teaching English language skills to business professionals in an online setting.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Teach one-on-one 20 min English classes to adults from basic to advanced levels
  • Follow the established teaching method
  • Fill out attendance and performance reports on students


REQUIREMENTS :

  • Full proficiency in English (C2)
  • Registered as Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) in Brazil
  • Intermediate or above level of Portuguese
  • Previous teaching experience
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection
  • Quiet, interruption-free workspace
  • Business knowledge is a plus
  • A sociable and communicative personality


Working Schedule:

Monday to Friday, in one of the following daily schedules:


WORK SCHEDULE A

7h to 10h

+ 12h to 14h

+ 16h to 18h30

(all 3 time slots combined)


WORK SCHEDULE B

9h to 11h

+ 13h to 15h

+ 17h to 20h30

(all 3 time slots combined)


PLEASE ONLY APPLY FOR THIS POSITION IF YOU HAVE ONE OF THE DAILY WORK SCHEDULES AVAILABLE!


Monthly Compensation:

1st and 2nd months: R$ 3,500.00

3rd and 4th months: R$ 3.750,00

5th month and after: R$ 4,000.00


Unique Payment Structure

A great advantage of our format is that you get paid for all the time you reserve for the students, regardless of whether they show up for class or not.


The student also has no discounts for cancelling or not showing up.

We also don’t offer replacement classes in case of cancellation or no-show.


This way we protect teachers payments and schedules.


Additional Opportunity for São Paulo residents:

Many of our online teachers also participate in our in-person immersions at LivEnglish.


So, in addition to this online position, if you live in the São Paulo city, you can also apply for the position of English teacher at the LivEnglish in-person immersions.


You could earn an additional R$ 1.200,00 for a weekend immersion. Let us know in the application if you'd like to apply for the LivEnglish immersion too.


Check out @imersaoemingles on Instagram to see what our immersions are like :-)


Payment is made to Brazilian banks only.


We look forward to meeting you!

title: Test Automation Developer
description:
Test Automation Developer

Brazil

Senior QA Automation Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek experienced high-performing Software Quality Engineers for positions involving quality assurance and test automation for a Private Cloud Platform solution aimed at enabling distributed Edge computing.

You will join a highly skilled team delivering a highly distributed private cloud platform supporting containerized applications in addition to supporting virtual machines and bare metal nodes.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Analyze requirements, create test plans and test cases, execute functional/exploratory tests;
  • Automate tests through use of test automation tools and through code development;
  • Interact with Software Development team in order to complete ticket cycles;
  • Analyze system and applications and propose test strategy;
  • Participate in technical discussions with customer;
  • Coordinate with development team to drive product quality;
  • Report/Monitor/Verify issues in defect tracking tool (JIRA, Bugzilla, etc);
  • Perform regression tests to validate fixes.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Python for testing;
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containers;
  • Knowledge of creating scripts using automated testing tools;
  • Experience working on Linux platforms.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience developing test cases/plans and ability to analyze code to identify root cause of issues;
  • Experience working with testing tools: Pytest Framework / Cypress;
  • Experience working in an Agile / Scrum / Kanban environment.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Marketing Strategist / Marketing Manager (SEO, AEO & Social Media)
description:
We are hiring a high-caliber Marketing Strategist / Marketing Manager who can both think strategically and execute consistently . This is not a coordination role. This is a performance role.

You will lead hands-on execution across:

  • SEO
  • AEO (Answer Engine Optimization)
  • Social media growth
  • Multi-channel campaigns
  • Event and community marketing


You will work directly with leadership and gradually take ownership of marketing execution across multiple markets.


If you are analytical, proactive, data-driven, and comfortable operating independently in a remote environment — this role is for you.


Key Responsibilities

1️⃣ Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Develop and execute measurable marketing initiatives aligned with business goals
  • Launch multi-channel campaigns driving engagement and conversions
  • Track ROI and optimize based on performance data
  • Support event and community-based marketing initiatives

2️⃣ SEO & AEO Execution

  • Implement on-page SEO best practices
  • Build and expand keyword clusters
  • Optimize content for:
  • Featured Snippets
  • Voice Search
  • AI-generated search results
  • Conversational search queries
  • Work with technical SEO partners
  • Use analytics tools to improve rankings and conversions

3️⃣ Content & Email Marketing

  • Create SEO-aligned content
  • Repurpose content across channels
  • Manage newsletters and promotional emails
  • Maintain brand consistency

4️⃣ Social Media Execution

  • Manage Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and YouTube
  • Improve engagement and visibility
  • Monitor performance metrics
  • Optimize based on data

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

title: Desenvolvedor Unreal Engine
description:
Programador Unreal (Pleno / Sênior / Especialista / Não aceitamos Juniors)Descrição da Vaga

Somos um estúdio indie em plena expansão. Estamos desenvolvendo um MMORPG de nova geração e outros 2 projetos próprios, e buscamos programadores de Unreal Engine que queiram crescer conosco em projetos reais de longo prazo. Aceitamos candidatos de qualquer país da América Latina. O trabalho é 100% remoto .

Site do estúdio:

Níveis que buscamos
  • Pleno (Normal-Medium) — Programadores com base sólida em C++ e conhecimento funcional de Unreal Engine 5. Capazes de receber instruções claras e executar com qualidade. Dispostos a aprender, melhorar constantemente e contribuir em projetos reais.
  • Sênior (Muito Bom) — Programadores com experiência comprovada em projetos com Unreal Engine. Domínio sólido de C++, Blueprints e pelo menos uma área especializada (replicação, otimização, sistemas de gameplay, UI, etc.). Capazes de resolver problemas complexos com autonomia e critério.
  • Especialista/Senior+ — Programadores sêniores com trajetória demonstrável em projetos complexos e multiplayer. Experiência sólida em replicação de rede (network replication), otimização de performance e arquitetura de sistemas. Capazes de liderar equipes, tomar decisões técnicas de alto nível, organizar outros programadores e documentar sistemas complexos.
Observação: Cada nível deve ser comprovado e demonstrado com portfólio, projetos anteriores ou teste técnico. Não buscamos diplomas — buscamos capacidade real.

title: Vendedor
description:
Descrição da Empresa : A Mentoria Doc10X é um Clube de Mentoria Digital focada no crescimento de carreiras de médicos que já possuem consultórios ou clínicas. Atualmente com quase 70 médicos, somos um dos Clubes Sócios da Mentoring League Society.


Integral


CLT


Júnior


R$ 3.000,00 - R$ 15.000,00


São José do Rio Preto, SP


Término das inscrições: 21/03/2026


Descrição do cargo

Estamos em busca de um closer para conduzir negociações estratégicas, desde a prospecção, passando pelo agendamento e o call de vendas de novos médicos para a Mentoria. O closer ficará responsável pelos leads gerados por funis e os que ja estão em nossos bancos de dados, garantindo a conversão de tais leads qualificados e o crescimento sustentável da empresa. O profissional será responsável por entender as necessidades dos clientes, oferecer soluções personalizadas e garantir uma experiência de compra excepcional.


Responsabilidades

Realizar negociações e fechar vendas, garantindo alta taxa de conversão.

Gerenciar o pipeline de vendas, acompanhando todas as etapas do processo comercial.

Entender as dores e necessidades do cliente, oferecendo soluções personalizadas.

Atuar em conjunto com SDRs e equipe de marketing, garantindo a qualidade dos leads.

Registrar e atualizar informações no CRM, acompanhando métricas e indicadores de performance.

Manter um relacionamento próximo com os clientes, garantindo retenção e recompra.

Aplicar técnicas avançadas de persuasão e fechamento para potencializar os resultados.


Requisitos

Habilidade de negociação e persuasão para conduzir conversas de fechamento.

Capacidade de comunicação clara e assertiva, garantindo confiança na negociação.

Proatividade e resiliência para lidar com objeções e desafios do processo comercial.

Organização e gestão do tempo para acompanhar leads e garantir follow-ups eficientes.

Familiaridade com metodologias de vendas, como SPIN Selling e Inside Sales.

Experiência em vendas consultivas ou negociação de alto valor.

O mais importante: ter ambiçao e ao mesmo tempo humildade, pois será treinado diretamente pelo CEO da empresa


Diferenciais

Histórico comprovado de boa performance em fechamento de vendas.


Experiência com produtos de alto ticket e mercados B2C.


Vivência com CRMs e ferramentas de automação comercial.


Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes perfis de clientes e segmentos de mercado.


Conhecimento em gatilhos mentais aplicados a vendas.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)
description:
Job Title: Marketing & Website Coordinator (Virtual Assistant)

Company : Elevated Tahoe Properties

Location : Remote


About Us

Elevated Tahoe Properties manages high-touch short-term rental and property portfolios focused on guest experience, operational excellence, and high-performing marketing that drives direct bookings. We’re hiring a proactive, creative, and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to support our website, digital marketing, social media, and lead generation efforts.

Our Company Culture:

  • We are a fun, young company growing quickly
  • We value open communication and adding in humor whenever possible
  • Our team is self driven and empowered to handle their own responsibilities without being micromanaged
  • We inspire each other to become the best version of ourselves we can possibly become. 
  • We lead by example and use positive reinforcement to inspire others to strive for personal and professional greatness.

Role Summary

You will be responsible for helping us grow our online presence and increase direct vacation rental bookings through website updates, landing page creation, lead capture strategy, email marketing, and social media content support. This role requires strong design instincts, attention to detail, marketing experience, and a solid understanding of WordPress, Elementor, and basic website coding.


Key Responsibilities


  • Manage and update our WordPress website using Elementor
  • Build and optimize landing pages designed to drive bookings and capture leads
  • Improve website layout, visuals, and user experience to support conversion goals
  • Help increase traffic to the website through organic and campaign-based marketing efforts
  • Develop compelling, conversion-focused copywriting that incorporates SEO best practices for all web and marketing assets
  • Edit and prepare social media content including short-form video, photos, graphics, and captions
  • Schedule and publish social media posts across relevant platforms
  • Monitor inbound leads and help organize follow-up and lead nurturing workflows
  • Create and manage nurture email campaigns for existing guests, past guests, and new leads
  • Support list building, audience segmentation, and email campaign improvements
  • Assist with marketing asset creation for promotions, campaigns, and seasonal offers
  • Maintain brand consistency across website pages, email marketing, and social media content
  • Collaborate with leadership on ideas to improve direct bookings, lead generation, and guest engagement

Qualifications


  • Proven experience in digital marketing, website management, or lead generation
  • Strong hands-on experience with WordPress and Elementor
  • Strong design skills with an eye for clean, polished, high-converting content
  • Experience editing social media video and photo content
  • Experience with email marketing platforms and nurture campaigns
  • Comfortable creating landing pages and understanding basic conversion strategy
  • Decent to strong website coding basics, including familiarity with HTML/CSS and light troubleshooting
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple moving pieces
  • Able to work independently, take initiative, and bring creative solutions to the table
  • Familiarity with Asana or similar project management tools

Non‑Negotiable Requirements

  • Reliable backup power (UPS or generator) to prevent downtime during outages
  • Dual monitors for efficient multitasking
  • Backup internet (secondary wired connection or mobile hotspot) with stable speeds
  • Quiet, dedicated workspace and dependable computer 

Preferred

  • Experience with the Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro) or similar creative tools
  • Strong video editing proficiency for creating engaging short-form content
  • Deep understanding of social media marketing trends, algorithms, and best practices
  • Experience working with hospitality, vacation rentals, real estate, or travel brands

Required Days/Hours

  • Monday - Friday 8AM to 5PM Pacific Time (1 hour unpaid Lunch Break)


Compensation Target:

$950 per month + monthly KPI bonus / 40 hours per week — salary negotiable based on experience.

What We Offer

  • Remote role supporting a growing vacation rental and hospitality brand
  • Opportunity to directly impact bookings, lead generation, and brand growth
  • Creative, collaborative team environment with room to contribute ideas and improve systems


How to Apply (only email applications will be considered)


Email :

Subject : The Marketing & Website Coordinator Your Team Needs


Include:

  • Your Resume/CV
  • ONE OF (listed in order of preference):
  • A link to your personal portfolio website
  • A comprehensive PDF format portfolio document
  • At list of at least 5 links of design and marketing work you’ve completed
  • Pre-Screening Form:
  • Internet Speed Verification:

Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the speed test results.

  • DISC Assessment:

  Note : Please only submit a screenshot of the DISC assessment results graph.

  • A 2–3 minute video that includes:

-Brief intro and summary of your experience

-Why you’re the ideal candidate for this position

-Your top 3 skills that make you an excellent marketing and design coordinator


﻿Only applicants who follow these instructions exactly and demonstrate strong attention to detail will be considered.


Thank you and we look forward to working with you!


~ Elevated Tahoe Properties Team

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Auditors of Certificates of Insurance


HOW THIS POSITION HELPS JONES SUCCEED

As an Auditor of Certificates of Insurance (COI) you will be responsible for verifying that the documents provided by tenants, vendors, and subcontractors in our platform have the necessary coverage required by our customers.


All the necessary training to perform the necessary tasks will be offered.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The high-level goal for this role is to help the company to deliver accurate audit resolutions in a timely manner.


  • This role demands a high level of commitment and dedication; this is a full-time, hands-on position requiring 40 hours per week, with occasional after-hours work as needed (including additional compensation).
  • This is not a role for someone seeking a casual or part-time opportunity; it demands undivided attention and cannot be reconciled with concurrent employment commitments


Be prepared for a fast-paced environment and to seek process improvements and personal development actively.


WHAT MAKES YOU A GREAT FIT

  • Be detail-oriented. High level of thoroughness, accuracy, organization, and productivity;
  • Communicate fluently in English (advanced written skills);
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week during American business hoursç

description:
Job Title: Content Project Manager – ELL

Function: Content Strategy & Production (English Language Learning)


About the Role

We’re looking for a Content Project Manager to support English Language Learning (ELL) projects in 2026. This role owns end-to-end project delivery, working closely with Client, internal teams and external vendors to ensure content is delivered on time, within budget, and to required quality standards.


It is a 12 month contract with 40 hours of weekly commitment, Monthly Rate: $1,000



Required Skills & Experience

• 2+ years of project management experience, MUST be in ELL or education publishing

• Experience managing vendors and cross-functional teams

• Strong understanding of project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, or similar)

• Proficiency in Smartsheet and Excel

• Strong planning, prioritization, and problem-solving skills

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities

• Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, global environment

Education

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience

  • PMP /PMI certification will be an added advantage

title: Especialista IA
description:
VAGA ABERTA: Especialista IA Sênior – Remoto


Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 30 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Especialista IA . Com matriz no Brasil e filiais em território internacional, oferecemos oportunidades para crescimento e desenvolvimento. Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!


Requisitos essenciais:


  • Experiência prática com LLMs e agentes de IA, incluindo chatbots, copilots e automação inteligente;
  • Experiência com Azure AI, Azure OpenAI e Copilot Studio;
  • Domínio de prompt engineering;
  • Experiência com integração de IA em aplicações backend;
  • Conhecimento em Python aplicado ao desenvolvimento de APIs utilizando FastAPI;
  • Experiência com orquestração de agentes, incluindo contexto, memória e uso de ferramentas;
  • Conhecimento de integração com Microsoft Graph API;
  • Experiência na avaliação de qualidade de respostas de IA;
  • Conhecimento de estratégias para redução de alucinações, controle de contexto e validação de respostas;
  • Entendimento de arquiteturas com backend centralizando autenticação, governança e execução de agentes;
  • Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation);
  • Experiência com embeddings, busca semântica e técnicas de chunking de dados;
  • Conhecimento em grounding e controle de contexto;
  • Pensamento crítico e foco em solução;
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em comportamentos de IA;
  • Comunicação clara com equipes técnicas e não técnicas;
  • Capacidade de tomada de decisão técnica baseada em trade-offs;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade;
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambiente com incerteza;
  • Colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Experiência com frameworks como Semantic Kernel;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de LLMOps;
  • Experiência com múltiplos modelos e estratégias de fallback;
  • Experiência com avaliação automatizada de respostas;
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada à IA;
  • Experiência com plataformas corporativas de grande porte
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.


Responsabilidades:


  • Definir e implementar o comportamento dos agentes de IA, incluindo fluxo de execução, controle de contexto, memória e uso de ferramentas externas;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir estratégias de prompt engineering;
  • Trabalhar com Azure AI e Copilot Studio na criação, ajuste e evolução de agentes;
  • Garantir a qualidade das respostas, promovendo consistência, precisão e redução de alucinações;
  • Implementar e evoluir soluções de RAG, incluindo ingestão de dados, definição de chunking, geração de embeddings e busca semântica;
  • Definir estratégias de grounding e uso de contexto confiável;
  • Integrar agentes com sistemas corporativos por meio da Microsoft Graph API;
  • Atuar em conjunto com backend Python em FastAPI para orquestração de chamadas de IA, controle de contexto e validação de respostas;
  • Definir padrões de governança de IA, incluindo controle de acesso, restrições de uso e auditoria de interações;
  • Definir e aplicar estratégias de avaliação de qualidade, incluindo testes de resposta, validação de consistência e melhoria contínua;
  • Apoiar decisões técnicas relacionadas à arquitetura de soluções de IA.


Nossos cuidados com você:

*Benefícios a variar de acordo com a modalidade de contrato


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição Ifood Empresas;

Benefício indireto (valor fixo para custeio parcial do plano de saúde ou somado ao vale alimentação);

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Sys Manager - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Auxílio Creche;

Assistência Médica;

title: DevOps Engineer (Spanish and Portuguese Speaking)
description:
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Manter e desenvolver a infraestrutura em nuvem da AWS (ECS, EC2, RDS, S3, VPC, etc.).
  • Garantir as práticas de observabilidade (monitoramento, alertas e logs) utilizando ferramentas como Prometheus, Grafana e CloudWatch.
  • Manter e desenvolver os pipelines de CI/CD no Bitbucket para aplicações em contêineres .NET, Python e Docker.
  • Apoiar e melhorar os processos de automação de testes (integração, regressão e desempenho).
  • Implementar estratégias de segurança na nuvem (IAM, roles, compliance, hardening).
  • Apoiar a equipe de engenharia no diagnóstico e resolução de incidentes críticos.
  • Propor melhorias de arquitetura, automação e governança na nuvem.
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes de engenharia e qualidade para garantir entregas rápidas e seguras.


Requisitos:
  • Experiência em ambientes com ASP.NET.
  • Mais de 4 anos de experiência trabalhando com AWS, utilizando serviços como EKS, ECS + Fargate, SQL Server + RDS, SQS, EC2, VPN, VPC, Transit Gateway, NAT Gateway e IAM.
  • CI/CD com Bitbucket Pipelines e integração com contêineres Docker.
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform ou AWS CDK).
  • Experiência com Linux e automação com Shell/Bash.
  • Conhecimento em contêineres e orquestração (Docker e ECS/Fargate).
  • Experiência com monitoramento e observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão e qualidade: Jira (gestão ágil) e SonarQube (code quality).
  • Conhecimentos básicos de bancos de dados (PostgreSQL e/ou SQL Server).
  • Controle de versão com Git (estratégias de Git Flow).


Sobre a vaga:
  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% remoto.
  • Ambiente internacional.
  • Tipo de contrato: PJ.

title: Cientista de Dados Especialista em IA
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Cientista de Dados Especialista em IA


Descrição da posição


Profissional atuará no desenvolvimento de soluções baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models), com foco na criação de prompts avançados e agentes de IA, apoiando a evolução de soluções analíticas aplicadas a produtos e plataformas digitais.


A atuação envolve o desenvolvimento de Prompt Engineering, integração com dados estruturados e não estruturados e construção de agentes inteligentes, garantindo qualidade, governança e confiabilidade das respostas geradas pelos modelos.


Responsabilidades


Desenvolver, testar e refinar prompts utilizando técnicas avançadas de Prompt Engineering, como Chain-of-Thought, Few-shot e ReAct

Criar e evoluir agentes de IA baseados em LLMs

Avaliar a performance de diferentes modelos e agentes para casos de uso específicos

Preparar e estruturar dados estruturados e não estruturados para alimentar modelos de linguagem

Garantir que prompts e agentes sigam diretrizes de segurança, governança e ética, evitando alucinações e outputs inconsistentes

Atuar em conjunto com diferentes áreas para integrar soluções de IA generativa em produtos e sistemas

Apoiar na construção de mecanismos de monitoramento e avaliação de outputs gerados por agentes de IA


Requisitos obrigatórios


Formação em Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Física ou áreas correlatas

Experiência prática no desenvolvimento de prompts e agentes de IA utilizando sistemas baseados em LLMs

Domínio de Python

Experiência em manipulação e análise de dados utilizando SQL

Experiência com modelagem preditiva e machine learning

Conhecimento do mercado de crédito ou produtos financeiros


  • Idioma: Inglês é considerado um diferencial, mas não obrigatório


E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full Stack Engineer - Opportunity in Brazil (100% remote)


Location: Fully Remote

Contract: PJ (open-ended)


About the Role

One of our US-based clients is looking for a kind, curious, and collaborative Senior Software Engineer (Full Stack) who enjoys solving complex and meaningful problems.

This team is responsible for building seamless and compelling experiences that make it easy for individuals to consign luxury items. We place a strong emphasis on personal growth, technical excellence, and a highly collaborative engineering culture.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a hands-on contributor while also influencing technical direction. You will lead impactful initiatives, participate in architectural decisions, and provide mentorship through thoughtful code reviews and pair programming.

If you are excited about luxury retail, e-commerce, or sustainability—and passionate about contributing to a circular economy for high-end goods—this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Build high-quality, performant, and testable code that supports company-wide initiatives
  • Develop with modern technologies including Elixir, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS (Lambda), PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB
  • Contribute to architectural and technical decisions shaping the future of our systems
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive, actionable feedback
  • Collaborate through pair programming and team-based feature development
  • Deploy user-facing features to production
  • Continuously learn and introduce new patterns, tools, and improvements


Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Fluency in Elixir or Ruby
  • Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript (ECMAScript) , HTML, and CSS
  • Experience with React and the broader React ecosystem (Node.js, npm)
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows
  • Familiarity with TypeScript
  • Understanding of event-based architectures
  • Strong database fundamentals
  • Experience working with GraphQL
  • Enthusiasm for solving user-centric problems with technology


Desired Skills

  • Experience with Kafka for event streaming
  • Experience extracting or building microservices from a monolithic architecture
  • Interest in luxury retail, e-commerce, or high-end consignment markets
  • Passion for sustainability and circular economy initiatives


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred
  • Equivalent professional experience considered

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a hands-on contributor while also influencing technical direction. You will lead impactful initiatives, participate in architectural decisions, and provide mentorship through thoughtful code reviews and pair programming.

If you are excited about luxury retail, e-commerce, or sustainability—and passionate about contributing to a circular economy for high-end goods—this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Build high-quality, performant, and testable code that supports company-wide initiatives
  • Develop with modern technologies including Elixir, Ruby, React, TypeScript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS (Lambda), PostgreSQL, and DynamoDB
  • Contribute to architectural and technical decisions shaping the future of our systems
  • Review pull requests and provide constructive, actionable feedback
  • Collaborate through pair programming and team-based feature development
  • Deploy user-facing features to production
  • Continuously learn and introduce new patterns, tools, and improvements


Required Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Fluency in Elixir or Ruby
  • Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript (ECMAScript) , HTML, and CSS
  • Experience with React and the broader React ecosystem (Node.js, npm)
  • Experience working with RESTful APIs
  • Proficiency with Git and version control workflows
  • Familiarity with TypeScript
  • Understanding of event-based architectures
  • Strong database fundamentals
  • Experience working with GraphQL
  • Enthusiasm for solving user-centric problems with technology


Desired Skills

  • Experience with Kafka for event streaming
  • Experience extracting or building microservices from a monolithic architecture
  • Interest in luxury retail, e-commerce, or high-end consignment markets
  • Passion for sustainability and circular economy initiatives


Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field preferred
  • Equivalent professional experience considered
