title: Digital Web Experience Solution Architect
description:
Digital Web Experience Solution Architect

São Paulo, Brazil/Buenos Aires, Argentina


Job Description

You were made to do this work: designing new technologies, diving into data, optimizing digital experiences, and constantly developing better, faster ways to get results. You want to be part of a performance culture dedicated to building technology for a purpose that matters. Here, you’ll work in an environment that promotes sustainability, inclusion, wellbeing, and career development while you help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.


In this role, you will:

  • Architect & implement scalable, secure, performant, and resilient approaches for brand websites that meet business and technical requirements.
  • Use modern CMS systems and MACH principles
  • Enable personalization, performance optimization, and measurable business outcomes
  • Comply with CPRA/CCPA, GDPR, and other data privacy and regulatory requirements
  • Manage current state documents including diagrams, operational runbooks, and future-state roadmaps
  • Align digital marketing strategies within the platform architecture and guidelines.
  • Apply principles around people, process, information, and technology to design
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to translate business needs into technical specifications and architectural designs.
  • Provide Full-Stack technical leadership and guidance to development teams on modern CMS systems for building dynamic and high-performing sites, ensuring best practices are followed.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new tools and technologies to enhance the digital experience.
  • Lead efforts to incorporate compliance features, such as consent management and secure data handling, into the architecture.
  • Collaborate with legal and compliance teams to ensure that architectural designs align with regulatory requirements.
  • Stay current with industry trends in digital experience platforms and architecture, continuously evaluating emerging technologies and best practices to keep our brand experiences cutting-edge.
  • Provide guidance on selecting technologies and tools that also support compliance and data protection.
  • Operational Ownership to ensure uptime and reliability of all brand sites through proactive monitoring, incident management, and performance optimization including incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve architectural challenges, ensuring that solutions are scalable, secure, and performant.
  • Mentor and support other architects and engineers within the team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and innovation.
  • Provide Legacy Support for existing sites during migration to MACH architecture where needed.


Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in solution architecture for large-scale, consumer-facing digital experiences.


Required expertise in:

  • Full Stack Development (Frontend: React; Backend: CMS, API-first).
  • Modern CMS solutions (headless and traditional), integration patterns, and best practices.
  • MACH architecture (Microservices, API-first, Cloud-native, Headless).
  • Cloud ecosystems (Azure or AWS) and cloud-native deployments.
  • Relational database design and optimization; advanced SQL skills.
  • Strong understanding of web technologies, frameworks, and security best practices.
  • Familiarity with containerization, composable architectures, and event-driven design


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience integrating Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) for unified customer profiles and personalization.
  • Knowledge of identity resolution and real-time personalization through event-driven data flows.
  • Exposure to eCommerce systems, personalization engines, or digital marketing technologies.

title: Analista de Crédito e Cobrança Pleno
description:
A AutoZone é a maior rede varejista de autopeças e acessórios automotivos do mundo ! Empresa Americana, estamos em plena expansão no Brasil, com mais de 149 lojas no país.


A AutoZone inaugurou sua primeira loja AutoZone do Brasil na cidade de Sorocaba em setembro de 2012. Nossa mentalidade de cliente em primeiro lugar e compromisso com Ir Além definem quem somos, tanto para nossos clientes quanto para os AutoZoners. Trabalhar na AutoZone significa fazer parte de uma equipe que valoriza a dedicação, o trabalho em equipe e o crescimento. Esteja você ajudando clientes ou construindo sua carreira, fornecemos ferramentas e suporte para ajudá-lo a ter sucesso e impulsionar seu futuro.

Com mais de 7.000 lojas em operação e presença consolidada em diversos países, a AutoZone é uma referência global no setor de autopeças e acessórios automotivos. No Brasil, seguimos em ritmo acelerado de expansão, com operações em sete estados: São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Santa Catarina, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná e Goiás.


Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos em ambientes inclusivos. Todas as pessoas, independentemente de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, idade ou deficiência, são bem-vindas para se candidatar.


Descrição Resumida:

Auxilia nas atividades de análise de crédito, faturamento, contas a receber e cobrança, atuando sob supervisão para garantir o processamento preciso e pontual das transações de crédito e contas a receber. Contribui para a eficiência e eficácia das operações do departamento.


Responsabilidades:

  • Apoio na análise de crédito: Responsável pela análise da capacidade de crédito dos clientes e na tomada de decisões com base nas políticas e procedimentos estabelecidos. Isso envolve a revisão de relatórios de crédito, demonstrações financeiras e históricos de pagamento para avaliar o risco de crédito, fazer liberação emergencial de limite de crédito, realizar validação e revisão cadastral dos clientes, realizar bloqueio e desbloqueio de cadastro conforme política interna.
  • Faturamento: Atuar no processo de faturamento, enviando faturas aos clientes de forma precisa e pontual. Isso inclui verificar as informações de cobrança, aplicar descontos ou ajustes apropriados e resolver divergências de faturamento.
  • Assistência na cobrança: Responsável nas atividades de cobrança, entrando em contato com clientes para acompanhar pagamentos em atraso e resolver pendências. Isso pode envolver o envio de lembretes, negociação de prazos e escalonamento de cobranças, quando necessário. Outras atividades de apoio à cobrança envolvem enviar relatórios de acompanhamento para as lojas e preparar envio de cartas de anuência.


Requisitos

  • Superior completo em Contabilidade, Administração ou experiência equivalentes;
  • Fortes habilidades de pesquisa e análise.
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita e habilidades de negociação.
  • Excelentes habilidades interpessoais, com comprovada capacidade de resolução de disputas.
  • Conhecimento de atividades de crédito, cobrança e contas a receber.
  • Experiência com atendimento ao cliente é um diferencial


Informações Adicionais

  • Tipo de contrato: CLT.
  • Benefícios: Assistência médica com participação, assistência odontológica, seguro de vida, vale-refeição, convênio em academias, programa de apoio ao AutoZoner e desconto de 20% em produtos nas lojas AutoZone.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a hands‑on Software Engineer to join the Developer Risk (DevRisk) team. You will build data-driven features and services that power developer review and enforcement workflows. The role spans querying large datasets, building back-end services and front-end review UI components, and implementing platform capabilities that improve risk detection and decision-making.

You will collaborate closely with data engineers, product managers, and reviewers to translate business criteria into robust tooling and dashboards, ensuring accuracy, performance, and end‑to‑end reliability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Data Querying & Reporting: Write efficient SQL queries to extract data from the DevRisk Data Warehouse and populate dashboards/spreadsheets to deliver required statistics and insights.
  • Policy & Criteria Improvements: Identify improvements to developer ban criteria based on data analysis and implement corresponding changes in DevRisk tooling and review UI.
  • Frontend (Review UI): Build pages and widgets in the reviewer UI to render critical information for decision-making; ensure usability, consistency, and performance.
  • Backend Services: Design and implement back-end services and APIs to power the review UI and related enforcement workflows.
  • Enforcement Platform: Design and implement platform functionality that enables accurate, auditable, and scalable developer enforcement.
  • Quality & Reliability: Perform end‑to‑end testing, optimization, and integration of implemented services; monitor performance and iterate based on feedback.
  • Documentation: Document data lineage, UI/UX behavior, and service contracts to support operability and governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Industry experience in software engineering or closely related areas.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C++, Java, or Python.
  • Strong experience with SQL for complex querying and data manipulation.
  • Fluency in English (reading, writing, speaking, and listening).


Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Java/C++/Python and SQL (multiple languages).
  • Experience with ETL and data pipelines (batch and/or streaming).
  • Hands‑on experience with version control, collaborative code reviews, and automated testing (e.g., Git/Gerrit, CI/CD, unit/integration/e2e testing).
  • Exposure to risk, trust & safety, enforcement systems, or policy tooling is a plus.
  • Familiarity with data modeling, observability (metrics, logging, tracing), and secure coding practices.


Tech Stack (Indicative)

  • Languages: Java, Python, C++
  • Data: SQL, Data Warehouse, ETL/ELT tools, spreadsheets/dashboarding
  • Backend: REST/gRPC services, microservices, authentication/authorization
  • Frontend: Component‑based UI (widgets/pages for reviewer workflows)
  • Testing: Unit, integration, E2E; CI/CD pipelines
  • Ops: Monitoring, alerting, performance tuning


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and a data‑driven mindset.
  • Ability to translate policy/business requirements into technical designs.
  • Ownership across the lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Excellent collaboration with cross‑functional partners and stakeholders.


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

  • Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)
description:
Customer Success Agent (Technical, 24/7 Operations)


TG Lab is a technology company powering some of the biggest winners in sports betting and online casino products. We provide player account management and engagement technology to industry leaders such as Stake.com, Belgium National Lottery, Betsson Group , and many others. Our innovative yet practical solutions fuel world-class real-money wagering technology that supports over 1 million players. Our iGaming software is designed for distribution to casino and sportsbook operators across the EU, USA , and Asia.


We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager (Technical) to join our 24/7 operations team, which operates at the core of platform stability, partner communication, and incident handling. In this role, you’ll work on the frontline monitoring platform health, investigating issues, and coordinating real-time responses to ensure stable and reliable operations for our partners. This role is about real-time reaction, investigation, coordination, and clear communication.


Responsibilities:  


  • Actively monitor platform health and alerts during your shift and react to incidents in real time
  • Investigate partner-raised issues and perform first-level technical analysis using logs and monitoring dashboards
  • Communicate clearly with partners during incidents, outages, and escalations
  • Own issues throughout their full life cycle: detection, investigation, coordination, and resolution
  • Create and manage Jira tickets and collaborate closely with cross-functional teams
  • Provide transparent updates internally and externally
  • Identify recurring issues and risks that may impact platform stability
  • Maintain accurate documentation and structured internal communication


Requirements:


  • Junior to early-mid level profile 
  • Strong written and verbal English skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-responsibility environment
  • Logical, analytical thinker with a structured approach to problem solving
  • Technically curious and comfortable working with system behavior, logs, and monitoring tools
  • Experience or familiarity with Jira, Slack, or similar tools
  • Able to work shifts, including nights, weekends, and holidays, as part of a 24/7 rotation
  • Calm under pressure and confident handling incidents and escalations


Things we consider as an advantage:


  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Success, Technical Support, NOC, or Operations
  • Experience with monitoring tools
  • Exposure to SaaS, platform-based products, or iGaming
  • Basic understanding of web technologies, APIs, or backend systems


Working with us implies:


  • Memorable company parties and social activities like team buildings and monthly birthday celebrations.
  • Working in a company with a global culture, experience, and reach.
  • Working on-site in our modern, bright, and comfortable office space located in downtown Foz do Iguaçu, with a great working atmosphere, a collaborative team of amazing people, and open-minded managers.
  • Opportunities to build valuable skills, work with unique and interesting projects for the sports industry, express and implement your ideas and grow your career.


The monthly salary range will depend on the selected candidate's experience and skills.

We will contact only shortlisted candidates.

title: Remote Retail Trade Specialist - 65112
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role overview:

We are looking for retail domain experts (5+ years experience) to create real-world, profession-based prompts and tasks. The role involves creating high quality prompts and documents to evaluate model responses on day-to-day work in retail operations, sales, and customer-facing environments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create realistic, first-person prompts based on actual job workflows
  • Design tasks that reflect real-world retail and sales scenarios
  • Select and use relevant public data/documents as input files
  • Ensure prompts are clear, specific, and aligned to the occupation
  • Review tasks for accuracy, completeness, and real-world relevance


Requirements:

  • Degree in Business, Pharmacy, Management, or related field
  • Strong understanding of real-world workflows in your profession

title: LLM Data Specialist (Python, AI Annotation, Research Tasks)
description:
Title: LLM Data Specialist (Python, AI Annotation, Research Tasks)

Location : Kenya (Remote)

Job Type : short term Contract


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly analytical professionals to join as S3 Annotators, responsible for producing and validating advanced OpenClaw trajectories for research-oriented tasks involving ambiguous goals, multi-step reasoning, and long-context workflows. This role requires strong problem-solving ability, research thinking, and the capability to justify decisions while executing complex, multi-tool workflows used to train sophisticated AI agents.


What does day-to-day look like

  • Create and validate OpenClaw trajectories for complex, research-oriented tasks
  • Work on tasks such as data analysis, web research, and document synthesis
  • Operate under underspecified or ambiguous goals, making logical and defensible decisions
  • Use Python (notebooks, scripts) for data processing, automation, and analysis
  • Perform workflows spanning multiple tools, environments, and applications
  • Clearly document both what actions were taken and why they were taken
  • Review and improve trajectory quality for reasoning depth and correctness
  • Collaborate with teams to refine evaluation standards and annotation frameworks.


Requirements

  • Background in research, data science, engineering, or related fields (academic or industry)
  • 5+ years of experience in Python / Bash, including experience with notebooks and data wrangling
  • Experience with OpenClaw or similar advanced environments
  • Experience with web research, scraping tools, or data analysis workflows
  • Ability to articulate reasoning behind decisions and steps
  • Experience handling multi-step workflows across tools or platforms
  • Exposure to LLM-based tools, AI systems, or agentic workflows


Nice to have

  • Academic research experience (thesis, publications, lab work)
  • Familiarity with evaluation methodologies or experimental design
  • Experience in AI evaluation, RLHF, or advanced annotation workflow

description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • A global organization that acquires and scales vertical market software companies delivering mission-critical solutions in specialized industries.


  • The company focuses on long-term growth, operational excellence, and customer success, providing acquired businesses with a permanent home where they can continue to thrive.


  • Operating with an active mergers and acquisitions strategy, the organization creates a fast-paced environment where finance and operations teams play a crucial role in integrating new businesses and driving scalable processes.


About the role

  • The Lead Finance Systems (Oracle NetSuite) Specialist is responsible for leading end-to-end ERP integration projects for newly acquired companies.


  • This role focuses on migrating legacy financial systems into a centralized Oracle NetSuite environment and ensuring alignment with standardized financial processes.


  • You will oversee discovery, configuration, migration, and post-go-live support with minimal oversight.


  • Working closely with finance leadership and operational teams, you will ensure data integrity, compliance, and successful adoption of the new systems.


  • This is a leadership role requiring both technical ERP expertise and strong project management skills.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end migration projects for newly acquired companies, including legacy ERP data migration and system configuration.


  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand current-state processes and design future-state configurations within Oracle NetSuite and connected tools.


  • Create and manage project plans, timelines, risks, and deliverables, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution.


  • Coordinate the migration of chart of accounts, vendors, customers, transactions, and ledger balances from legacy ERPs into NetSuite.


  • Lead configuration and deployment of core modules within NetSuite (e.g., GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Bank Recs, etc.).


  • Standardize financial processes across acquired entities to align with group policies and reporting standards.


  • Collaborate with accounting and finance teams to ensure business readiness for go-live and support month-end close activities post-migration.


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, including acquired company finance teams, internal technical resources, and group leadership.


  • Present regular updates and recommendations to the group finance and senior leadership.


  • Document system configurations, process flows, and migration procedures for knowledge transfer and audit purposes.


  • Contribute to the refinement of deployment methodologies and onboarding playbooks to drive scalability and efficiency.


Must have skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.


  • 4+ years of experience in ERP migration, financial systems implementation, or post-merger integration.


  • Hands-on experience with Oracle NetSuite, including system configuration and data migration.


  • Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes, including multi-entity, intercompany, consolidation, and reporting structures.


  • Proven ability to manage complex projects independently and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


  • Experience with SQL (4+ years).


  • NetSuite experience.


  • Architectural design experience.


  • Integration experience.


  • Leadership experience.


  • Strong analytical, organizational, and detail-oriented mindset.


Nice to have skills

  • CPA designation.


  • Experience with tools and technologies such as OneWorld, SuiteSuccess, SuiteCloud, ETL processes, CSV imports, data mapping, data cleansing, and integration frameworks.


  • Experience with the implementation and integration of financial systems.


  • Strong collaboration skills.


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-4 with at least 6 hours of overlap required with U.S. time zones.


  • Contractor role — 12-month contract, renewable.


  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).


  • BYOD (bring your own device) required.

  • This role focuses on migrating legacy financial systems into a centralized Oracle NetSuite environment and ensuring alignment with standardized financial processes.


  • You will oversee discovery, configuration, migration, and post-go-live support with minimal oversight.


  • Working closely with finance leadership and operational teams, you will ensure data integrity, compliance, and successful adoption of the new systems.


  • This is a leadership role requiring both technical ERP expertise and strong project management skills.


Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end migration projects for newly acquired companies, including legacy ERP data migration and system configuration.


  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand current-state processes and design future-state configurations within Oracle NetSuite and connected tools.


  • Create and manage project plans, timelines, risks, and deliverables, ensuring on-time and high-quality execution.


  • Coordinate the migration of chart of accounts, vendors, customers, transactions, and ledger balances from legacy ERPs into NetSuite.


  • Lead configuration and deployment of core modules within NetSuite (e.g., GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Bank Recs, etc.).


  • Standardize financial processes across acquired entities to align with group policies and reporting standards.


  • Collaborate with accounting and finance teams to ensure business readiness for go-live and support month-end close activities post-migration.


  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, including acquired company finance teams, internal technical resources, and group leadership.


  • Present regular updates and recommendations to the group finance and senior leadership.


  • Document system configurations, process flows, and migration procedures for knowledge transfer and audit purposes.


  • Contribute to the refinement of deployment methodologies and onboarding playbooks to drive scalability and efficiency.


Must have skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.


  • 4+ years of experience in ERP migration, financial systems implementation, or post-merger integration.


  • Hands-on experience with Oracle NetSuite, including system configuration and data migration.


  • Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes, including multi-entity, intercompany, consolidation, and reporting structures.


  • Proven ability to manage complex projects independently and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


  • Experience with SQL (4+ years).


  • NetSuite experience.


  • Architectural design experience.


  • Integration experience.


  • Leadership experience.


  • Strong analytical, organizational, and detail-oriented mindset.


Nice to have skills

  • CPA designation.


  • Experience with tools and technologies such as OneWorld, SuiteSuccess, SuiteCloud, ETL processes, CSV imports, data mapping, data cleansing, and integration frameworks.


  • Experience with the implementation and integration of financial systems.


  • Strong collaboration skills.


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-4 with at least 6 hours of overlap required with U.S. time zones.


  • Contractor role — 12-month contract, renewable.


  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).


  • BYOD (bring your own device) required.

title: ServiceNow Applications Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) ServiceNow Applications Engineer com forte expertise em AppEngine , desenvolvimento de aplicações customizadas e automação de processos, para atuar em um ambiente altamente técnico e colaborativo.

O(a) profissional será responsável por liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento, governança de plataforma e soluções de automação industrial, combinando visão estratégica, excelência técnica e interação com múltiplas áreas do negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver aplicações e workflows customizados em ServiceNow (AppEngine, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub)
  • Projetar soluções escaláveis, seguras e aderentes às melhores práticas da plataforma
  • Integrar ServiceNow com sistemas externos via REST/SOAP
  • Criar e manter Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs e UI Policies
  • Orientar desenvolvedores juniores e plenos, incluindo code reviews e mentoring
  • Garantir governança da plataforma, reusabilidade e qualidade técnica das entregas
  • Desenvolver e sustentar aplicações de processo e automação industrial, utilizando tecnologias de Controle Avançado e Otimizadores em tempo real
  • Participar de projetos estratégicos, atuando como referência técnica e colaborando em melhorias cross-funcionais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Inglês avançado/fluente
  • Experiência sólida com:
  • JavaScript e Glide API
  • ServiceNow AppEngine
  • Flow Designer
  • Script Includes, Business Rules, ACLs, UI Policies
  • Integrações via REST/SOAP
  • Experiência com HRSD, S2P e outros módulos/plugins ServiceNow
  • Vivência com DevOps, ATF e GitHub
  • Experiência em automação industrial / controle de processos
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias de refino e processos químicos
  • Experiência com Multivariable Predictive Control (AspenTech DMC, Honeywell RMPCT)
  • Experiência com Real-Time Optimizers (RoMeo ou similares)


Diferenciais

  • Certificações ServiceNow:
  • Flow Designer
  • IntegrationHub
  • Automated Test Framework
  • Service Portal
  • Performance Analytics
  • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
  • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
  • CIS (Certified Implementation Specialist)
  • CTA (Certified Technical Architect)


Onde você vai trabalhar?

100% remoto. No conforto de sua casa.

title: Endpoint Packaging Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Endpoint Packaging Engineer who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will:

SCCM/MECM and Intune (Windows packaging & deployment)

* JAMF Pro (macOS packaging)

* MSI/EXE/PowerShell for Windows; PKG/DMG/shell scripting for macOS

* ServiceNow


And much better if you stand out for:

PowerShell automation, MSIX, App-V, custom scripting

* Hybrid SCCM–Intune co-management experience

title: Senior Director of Marketing, Edtech
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale, and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


We’re seeking a results-oriented Senior Director of Marketing to lead global marketing and brand strategies for JoVE’s education and science research solutions. The ideal candidate will set the strategic vision, proactively develop and oversee the execution of data-driven programs to drive demand, accelerate revenue growth, and deepen brand engagement across educators, researchers, and librarians worldwide.


Responsibilities:


  • Develop and own the global marketing and brand strategy with a primary focus on generating qualified leads and converting them into meaningful engagement actions, including trial requests and product adoption.
  • Lead and scale a high-performing global marketing team of 20+ specialists across Campaigns, Outreach, Communications, and Events, owning performance and delivery against KPIs.
  • Drive initiatives that strengthen brand recognition and awareness while positioning JoVE as a go-to resource for education and science research.
  • Design and execute audience engagement strategies that attract, nurture, and convert prospects into trial users and active leads.
  • Plan and oversee the execution of integrated, multi-channel demand generation campaigns including email, social, webinars, events, and thought leadership.
  • Establish clear KPIs, and conversion metrics; monitor ROI and funnel impact, and continuously optimize programs to improve lead quality and conversion rates.


Requirements :


  • 10+ years of experience in marketing and brand. Experience in EdTech, academic publishing or SaaS is preferred.
  • 7+ years of management experience, successfully leading high-performing teams in a global environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to proactively develop and execute innovative marketing programs that generate leads, convert them into engaged users (e.g., trials, demos, or similar engagement actions), and drive revenue growth.
  • Strong experience managing integrated, multi-channel marketing programs across email, social, events, webinars, content, and thought leadership.
  • Experience with Hubspot and Salesforce is required.
  • Results-driven, proactive, and thrives in a fast paced environment.


Why Join JoVE?


  • A competitive compensation package.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.
  • Our strong promotion from within culture draws a clear path to advance your career with us.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Crypto Broker
description:
InvesTec UAE is a fast-growing, globally oriented investment and fintech company with strong roots in Indonesia and a rapidly expanding international footprint. We specialize in digital assets, crypto trading infrastructure, and institutional-grade brokerage solutions. Our mission is to bridge traditional finance with the evolving world of blockchain by delivering liquidity, transparency, and scalable trading services to clients worldwide.


As part of our expansion into Latin America, we are seeking a driven and client-focused Crypto Broker to support and grow our trading operations in Brazil. This is a fully remote role offering the opportunity to work closely with high-net-worth individuals, active traders, and institutional clients in one of the fastest-growing crypto markets globally.


Key Responsibilities
  • Source, onboard, and manage relationships with clients including HNWIs, professional traders, and institutional participants.
  • Execute crypto trades on behalf of clients, ensuring best execution, pricing, and liquidity.
  • Provide market insights, trading ideas, and ongoing support to clients to enhance trading activity.
  • Monitor crypto market conditions, price movements, and liquidity across major exchanges.
  • Coordinate with internal trading desks and liquidity providers to execute large or complex orders.
  • Maintain high levels of client satisfaction through proactive communication and relationship management.
  • Ensure compliance with internal procedures and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to grow trading volume and expand the client base in Brazil.


Requirements
  • Proven experience as a broker, trader, or sales professional in cryptocurrency, fintech, or financial markets.
  • Strong understanding of crypto markets, exchanges, order types, and trading strategies.
  • Experience handling client relationships and executing trades in a fast-paced environment.
  • Existing network of traders, investors, or crypto clients is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills.
  • Fluent English; Portuguese is highly preferred.
  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working remotely.


What We Offer
  • Competitive annual salary: USD 60,000 – 75,000
  • Performance-based bonuses tied to trading volume and client activity
  • Fully remote role with flexible working hours
  • Opportunity to work with global clients and advanced trading infrastructure
  • Exposure to high-growth crypto markets and institutional trading environments
  • Dynamic, international team with strong expertise in digital assets


This is an excellent opportunity for a results-driven professional to build strong client relationships, drive trading activity, and grow within a rapidly expanding global crypto brokerage business.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora .NET - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Backend .NET - Pleno, para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Desenvolver aplicações Backend .NET

Manter e evoluir sistemas existentes , analisando e depurando códigos com ferramentas como IDEs e DevTools do navegador (F12).

Desenvolver e manter APIs REST com .NET Core e Entity Framework.

Aplicar boas práticas de arquitetura de software , como DDD (Domain-Driven Design), injeção de dependência e testes unitários.

Trabalhar com mensageria , principalmente RabbitMQ, mas também com alternativas como SQS, SNS ou Kafka.

Projetar e manter sistemas distribuídos baseados em microserviços.

Monitorar e diagnosticar aplicações usando ferramentas de observabilidade (ex: DataDog, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch).

Utilizar bancos de dados não relacionais , como MongoDB ou DynamoDB.

Participar de pipelines de CI/CD , garantindo entregas contínuas e seguras.

Trabalhar com tecnologias de containerização e orquestração , como Docker e Kubernetes.

Utilizar serviços em nuvem (AWS, Azure, etc.) , incluindo funções serverless e mensageria.

Colaborar em projetos via Azure DevOps , utilizando boards, pipelines e repositórios.

Requisitos e qualificações

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiencia com .NET
  • EntityFramework
  • Injeção de Dependencia
  • DDD
  • Testes unitários
  • Experiencia com ferramentas de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Sqs, Sns, Kafka), preferencialmente RabbitMQ
  • Experiencia com sistemas distribuídos, com microserviços que interagem entre si;
  • Experiencia com alguma ferramenta de observabilidade/logs, como DataDog, azuremonitor; CloudWatch
  • Banco de dados não relacional (MongoDB, DynamoDB)
  • Experiencia com ambiente de trabalho com estrutura de CI-CD
  • Experiencia com pelo menos 3 ferramentas de Cloud(Exemplo: Aws lambda, Azure functions, SQS, SNS, EC2)
  • Experiencia com docker e kubernetes;
  • Experiencia ou conhecimento do Azure DevOps


Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.

title: Partner Technical Advisor
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career! Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are seeking a highly skilled for a Partner Technical Advisor who wants to learn and transform his career.


Responsibilities:


  • Design, architect, build PoCs (Proof of concept) and support customer and partner requirements · Drive technical sales support to customers
  • Present innovation, features and standard architectures, Demos and POCs
  • Build customer and partner ready presentations, materials
  • Provide training to customers and partners
  • Conduct workshops for customers and partners via web or on-site (availability to travel across the country).
  • Maintain updated info on all activities within one´s work sphere Continuously scan the environment for new business/technology.
  • Participate in the development of strategic plans to support commercial and pre-sales activities. · Manage the flow of information in a timely and correct manner.
  • Manage calendars and schedule meetings.
  • Perform a variety of administrative tasks and support management
  • Create and present performance reports to C-levels
  • Cross Group Collaboration
  • Work in partnership across multiple v-teams
  • Create Team training plan to be up to date with new Microsoft Technologies or features
  • Planning and organization capacity


Must have:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related
  • Experience in pre-sales of Microsoft Technologies
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
  • Discretion and confidentiality
  • Assertive communication
  • Self-management
  • Self-motivated
  • Problem management
  • Resilience
  • Proactive
  • Excellent time management skills
  • At least one certification in Microsoft Technologies (Fundamentals) o MS-900, AZ-900, DP-900, AI-900, SC-900, MB-910, MB-920


Good to have:

  • Speaker (Training) at events, workshops or/and training sessions
  • Knowledge in Agile methodologies


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


  • TCS Benefits – Brazil:
  • Health insurance
  • Dental Plan
  • Life insurance
  • Transportation vouchers
  • Meal/Food Voucher
  • Childcare assistance
  • Gympass
  • TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates
  • Partnership with SESC
  • Reimbursement of Certifications
  • Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training
  • International experience opportunity
  • Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools
  • Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire
  • TCS Gems – Recognition for performance
  • Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform



At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
Localização: Remoto

Tipo de contratação: Tempo integral

Contrato: A combinar


Descrição da vaga

Estamos procurando um(a) Senior Account Manager para gerenciar relacionamentos com clientes e apoiar a coordenação de projetos de marketing e publicidade. Este profissional atuará como ponto de contato entre clientes e equipes internas, garantindo que as iniciativas sejam organizadas e executadas de forma eficiente.


Responsabilidades

Gerenciar e manter relacionamento com contas de clientes.

Atuar como principal ponto de contato entre clientes e equipes internas.

Compreender os objetivos dos clientes e apoiar a implementação de iniciativas de marketing.

Acompanhar o progresso de projetos e campanhas.

Monitorar resultados e preparar relatórios de desempenho quando necessário.

Colaborar com equipes de marketing, mídia e criação para garantir a execução das campanhas.


Requisitos

Experiência em gestão de contas, marketing, publicidade ou áreas relacionadas.

Boas habilidades de comunicação e relacionamento profissional.

Capacidade de organizar e acompanhar múltiplos projetos simultaneamente.

Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados.

Capacidade de trabalhar em colaboração com diferentes equipes.


Benefícios

Remuneração compatível com o mercado.

Ambiente de trabalho profissional e colaborativo.

Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
A US Academy of Esthetics é uma empresa de transição de vida profissional focada no direcionamento e certificação de profissionais da saúde (médicos e dentistas) por meio de programas premium com padrão americano para atuação na Harmonização Orofacial e Corporal.

Objetivo:

Estamos buscando um parceiro de marketing para:

  • Gerar leads qualificados (médicos e dentistas)
  • Vender programas de certificação high ticket
  • Construir autoridade internacional e posicionamento premium da marca

Escopo da oportunidade:

Esperamos suporte nas seguintes áreas:

  • Estratégia de funil (preferencialmente perpétuo)
  • Gestão de tráfego pago (Meta, Google e YouTube)
  • Copywriting (nível high ticket)
  • Estratégia de conteúdo (foco em autoridade, não apenas postagem)
  • Produção de conteúdo (diferencial, mas não obrigatório)

O que NÃO buscamos:

  • Estratégias voltadas para captação de pacientes
  • Gestão genérica de redes sociais
  • Foco em engajamento superficial (likes, seguidores, etc.)

O que esperamos:

  • Experiência comprovada com produtos high ticket
  • Experiência com educação, mentorias ou certificações
  • Domínio de funis de vendas e conversão
  • Abordagem orientada a dados (CAC, ROAS, LTV)
  • Proficiência em Inglês para se comunicar com nosso CEO

KPIs:

  • Custo por lead qualificado
  • Taxa de conversão
  • Custo de aquisição de cliente (CAC)
  • Retorno sobre investimento em mídia (ROAS)

Perguntas a responder na sua aplicação:

  • Quais produtos high ticket vocês já venderam?
  • Vocês trabalham com funil perpétuo ou lançamentos?
  • Quem é responsável pelo copywriting?
  • Quais canais de tráfego vocês operam?
  • Podem compartilhar cases com resultados mensuráveis?

NOTA DE POSICIONAMENTO:

Nosso posicionamento está mais próximo de:

Educação internacional premium (estilo Ivy League)

E NÃO de:

  • Marketing para clínicas ou captação de pacientes



REMUNERAÇÃO:

R$ 5.000,00 por mês

title: DESENVOLVIMENTO E PROGRAMACAO ESPECIALISTA
description:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvimento e Programação Especialista (DEVES) para se juntar ao nosso time. Este profissional será responsável por desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar integrações em IBM ACE, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance. Além disso, irá projetar e implementar APIs e serviços SOA, seguindo padrões corporativos de arquitetura e conduzir iniciativas de modernização de integrações, reduzindo acoplamento e aumentando escalabilidade. O(a) DEVES também apoiará a evolução para arquiteturas cloud-native, integrando soluções on-premise e cloud, garantindo padrões de segurança, governança e qualidade de código.


Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida com IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE) / IBM Integration Bus (IIB) em ambientes produtivos.

- Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de integração, APIs REST/SOAP, mensageria e padrões SOA.

- Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs corporativas, incluindo versionamento, segurança e governança.

- Vivência em modernização de integrações legadas, migrando soluções monolíticas ou ESB tradicionais para arquiteturas mais modernas.

- Experiência prática com Java e/ou Go aplicados a integrações e serviços.

- Conhecimento em Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e conceitos de containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Domínio de boas práticas de segurança (OAuth2, JWT, TLS, mTLS).

- Experiência com pipelines CI/CD e automação de deploy.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

- Experiência com IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE) / IBM Integration Bus (IIB) em ambientes produtivos.

- Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de integração, APIs REST/SOAP, mensageria e padrões SOA.

- Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs corporativas, incluindo versionamento, segurança e governança.

- Vivência em modernização de integrações legadas, migrando soluções monolíticas ou ESB tradicionais para arquiteturas mais modernas.

- Experiência prática com Java e/ou Go aplicados a integrações e serviços.

- Conhecimento em Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e conceitos de containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Domínio de boas práticas de segurança (OAuth2, JWT, TLS, mTLS).

- Experiência com pipelines CI/CD e automação de deploy.


Benefícios:

- Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

- Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

- Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

- Mentoring;

- Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

- Assistência Médica;

- Assistência Odontológica;

- Clube de viagens;

- Convênio para Pet;

- e muito mais...

Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvimento e Programação Especialista (DEVES) para se juntar ao nosso time. Este profissional será responsável por desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar integrações em IBM ACE, garantindo alta disponibilidade e performance. Além disso, irá projetar e implementar APIs e serviços SOA, seguindo padrões corporativos de arquitetura e conduzir iniciativas de modernização de integrações, reduzindo acoplamento e aumentando escalabilidade. - Experiência sólida com IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE) / IBM Integration Bus (IIB) em ambientes produtivos.

- Forte conhecimento em arquitetura de integração, APIs REST/SOAP, mensageria e padrões SOA.

- Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento e sustentação de APIs corporativas, incluindo versionamento, segurança e governança.

- Vivência em modernização de integrações legadas, migrando soluções monolíticas ou ESB tradicionais para arquiteturas mais modernas.

- Experiência prática com Java e/ou Go aplicados a integrações e serviços.

- Conhecimento em Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) e conceitos de containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Domínio de boas práticas de segurança (OAuth2, JWT, TLS, mTLS).

- Experiência com pipelines CI/CD e automação de deploy.

title: Proofreader (TEMP CONTRACT)
description:
Proofreader


LegalSight is an international legal services and technology company. We are currently hiring for a division of the company which focuses on providing services to law firms across the United States.


As a Proofreader, you will work on a diverse range of immigration-related template, forms, and letters, applying a range of writing and editing skills to understand our clients' needs and ensuring our letters meet the highest quality standards. A Junior Proofreader must be proficient in basic and advanced grammar rules and understand how they are used within our style guides. Our ideal candidate is meticulous in reviewing copy, noting errors such as punctuation, spelling, and word usage, and knows how to check statements for accuracy.


This is a temporary contract role. The duration of the contract will be mid/end April 206 to end of June 2026. Working hours during this period will be Monday – Friday 9:00AM – 5:00PM Eastern Standard Time.


Main Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Review documents for grammar, spelling, and style
  • Fact-check dates and other statements for accuracy
  • Make corrections and suggest edits
  • Manage multiple proofreading projects and meet proofreading deadlines
  • Communicate effectively with the writers and other staff to ensure documents meet all company guidelines


Requirements:

  • A strong education background
  • English proficiency (speaking and writing)
  • Expert command of English grammar and punctuation
  • Exceptional fluency with Microsoft Word, including relevant shortcuts and advanced features like Paragraphs, Styles, Templates, and Mail Merge fields
  • Highly-focused and detail-oriented
  • Proven ability to multitask, exhibit flexibility, and remain responsive as demands change
  • Ability to work well in both independent and highly collaborative settings
  • Ability to excel in fast-paced work environment

title: Desenvolvimento Python Pleno AWS - 124355
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Responsabilidades: Desenvolver e manter aplicações complexas em Python, com foco em performance, escalabilidade e segurança. Contribuir com a arquitetura e design de sistemas de grande porte, visando soluções robustas e eficientes. Colaborar ativamente em todas as fases do desenvolvimento de software, desde a concepção até a implementação e manutenção. Mentorizar e compartilhar conhecimentos com desenvolvedores mais juniores, contribuindo para o crescimento do time. Implementar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados), garantindo a qualidade do código. Trabalhar com integração contínua e pipelines de DevOps, promovendo a automação de processos. Participar de code reviews, propondo melhorias e boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Manter-se atualizado com novas tecnologias e práticas do mercado, trazendo inovações para os projetos. Requisitos: Experiência sólida de 5+ anos com desenvolvimento em Python. Profundo conhecimento de frameworks como Django, Flask, FastAPI ou similares. Experiência em integração de APIs RESTful, microserviços e sistemas distribuídos. Sólidos conhecimentos de bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis). Experiência com testes automatizados (pytest, unittest) e ferramentas de integração contínua (Jenkins, GitLab CI). Experiência em ambientes de cloud computing, como AWS, Google Cloud ou Azure. Conhecimento de práticas de segurança em desenvolvimento de software. Familiaridade com containerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes). Habilidade de trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação para interagir com áreas multidisciplinares. Capacidade de analisar e resolver problemas complexos de forma eficiente.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

#VamosVoarJuntos

#ProudToBeGFT

title: Delivery Lead
description:
Required Skills & Experience


5+ years of experience in delivery lead role

Experience delivering data and analytics products in a production environment

Working knowledge of:

• ETL processes and data pipelines

• BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau

Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between business, product, and engineering teams

Demonstrated ability to identify issues early and escalate effectively


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


Experience supporting logistics, transportation, or pricing analytics initiatives

Background working with Azure-based data ecosystems

Familiarity with database backends and data modeling concepts

Experience operating in complex, cross-functional enterprise environments


Job Description


Insight Global is looking to add a Delivery Lead to their client’s Data & Analytics organization. This person will own the end-to-end delivery of logistics and transportation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time with high quality and operational reliability. They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will work closely with engineers to provide business context, facilitate effective technical discussions, and proactively identify and escalate risks related to delivery quality and timelines. This role also leads or supports incident management for data, analytics, and logistics systems by triaging issues, determining actionability, collaborating with engineering on resolution, and ensuring incidents are documented and addressed to prevent recurrence. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.


Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!


#Vempraília


Sobre a vaga:

  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para definir, projetar e lançar novos recursos;
  • Elaborar e conduzir refinamentos técnicos de demandas trazidas pelo time de produtos;
  • Atuar na manutenção da saúde e qualidade do codebase, equilibrando novas funcionalidades com resolução de débitos técnicos;
  • Desenvolver soluções escaláveis e que irão ser utilizadas por milhões de usuários;
  • Ser crítico em relação a Monitoria e Observabilidade;
  • Atuar na manutenção dos testes automatizados, incluindo criação de novos;
  • Orientar desenvolvedores de menor senioridade e auxiliar no desenvolvimento destes;
  • Elaboração de documentação técnica de novas funcionalidades;
  • Participar das cerimônias junto com os demais integrantes da equipe.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência com Java 17+, Spring Boot e Hibernate;
  • Experiência com Node.js + NestJS;
  • Experiência Bancos de Dados (SQL e NoSQL);
  • Oracle;
  • MongoDB;
  • RDS;
  • Experiência com comunicação por mensageria (RabbitMQ e SQS);
  • Experiência, compreensão e entendimento de arquitetura de micro serviços;
  • Experiência com Design de APIs REST;
  • Experiência com Testes Unitários (jUnit 5) e Testes Contrato (Pact);
  • Experiência com Axway - API Gateway;
  • Experiência com Git e Versionamento de Código;
  • Experiência com Dynatrace;
  • Conhecimento de Clean Code, Clean Architecture e Modularização;
  • Boas práticas de código, documentação e desenvolvimento de telas e componentes;
  • Experiência com em metodologias ágeis;
  • Excelentes habilidades para resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Estar disposto a buscar novos conhecimentos e encarar novos desafios;
  • Experiencia em projetos de alta complexidade técnica e de processos.

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

title: Brazil Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.


Role Description


We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.


Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.


Responsibilities


The successful candidate will be responsible for:


- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets


Qualifications


- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Blockchain Payments Coordinator
description:
InvesTec UAE is a forward-looking technology company operating at the intersection of fintech and blockchain innovation. We are focused on building efficient, scalable financial infrastructure powered by digital assets, enabling seamless global payments through blockchain technology.


As we expand our operations, we are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Blockchain Payments Coordinator to support and optimize our crypto payment processes. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the core of digital asset operations and contribute to the evolution of next-generation financial systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily blockchain payment operations, including transaction processing, monitoring, and tracking.
  • Assist in managing crypto wallets, ensuring accuracy in transfers and balances.
  • Support reconciliation of transactions across wallets, exchanges, and internal systems.
  • Monitor payment flows and identify discrepancies or operational issues.
  • Collaborate with operations, compliance, and finance teams to ensure smooth and compliant processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of transactions and prepare operational reports.
  • Assist in managing relationships with payment providers, exchanges, and blockchain partners.
  • Stay updated on blockchain trends, tools, and best practices to improve operational efficiency.


Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in crypto, blockchain operations, fintech, or payments coordination.
  • Basic understanding of blockchain networks, wallets, and cryptocurrency transactions.
  • Familiarity with stablecoins (e.g., USDT, USDC) and crypto exchanges is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Good communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment.


What We Offer

  • Competitive annual salary: BRL 180,000–220,000
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours across Brazil
  • Opportunity to gain hands-on experience in blockchain payments and digital asset operations
  • Exposure to cutting-edge fintech and Web3 technologies
  • Supportive and collaborative international team environment
  • Professional growth and learning opportunities in a rapidly evolving industry
  • Performance-based bonuses linked to operational accuracy and efficiency

  • Assist in managing crypto wallets, ensuring accuracy in transfers and balances.
  • Support reconciliation of transactions across wallets, exchanges, and internal systems.
  • Monitor payment flows and identify discrepancies or operational issues.
  • Collaborate with operations, compliance, and finance teams to ensure smooth and compliant processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of transactions and prepare operational reports.
  • Assist in managing relationships with payment providers, exchanges, and blockchain partners.
  • Stay updated on blockchain trends, tools, and best practices to improve operational efficiency.

  • 1–3 years of experience in crypto, blockchain operations, fintech, or payments coordination.
  • Basic understanding of blockchain networks, wallets, and cryptocurrency transactions.
  • Familiarity with stablecoins (e.g., USDT, USDC) and crypto exchanges is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Good communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment.


What We Offer

  • Competitive annual salary: BRL 180,000–220,000
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours across Brazil
  • Opportunity to gain hands-on experience in blockchain payments and digital asset operations
  • Exposure to cutting-edge fintech and Web3 technologies
  • Supportive and collaborative international team environment
  • Professional growth and learning opportunities in a rapidly evolving industry
  • Performance-based bonuses linked to operational accuracy and efficiency

title: Travel Designer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Travel Designer to plan and execute highly curated itineraries for a sophisticated and growing global clientele.

This is a client-facing role focused on delivering seamless, personalized service. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of luxury hospitality, understands the expectations of affluent travelers, and can manage multiple requests while transforming travel inspiration into flawlessly executed journeys.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams and trusted global partners to ensure every trip reflects the highest standards of luxury and service.

Profile

You are passionate about travel, detail-oriented, and skilled at building strong relationships with discerning clients. You intuitively understand their preferences and expectations, delivering highly personalized journeys with professionalism and care. Every interaction you lead reflects a refined standard of luxury service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bespoke, end-to-end itineraries tailored to each client’s travel style and preferences
  • Create and maintain long-term client relationships through prompt, thoughtful communication and flawless planning experience
  • Provide expert destination guidance with a strong understanding of luxury hospitality standards
  • Oversee all aspects of trip planning, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and seamless execution

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in luxury travel design, high-end hospitality, concierge, account management, or another sector within the luxury industry
  • Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus)
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple complex itineraries in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining exceptional service standards
  • CV in English

description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack Sênior, com forte viés em backend , para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas do Brasil. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar.


Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco.

Aqui, a Engenharia é tratada como cidadã de primeira classe: você terá voz ativa, participará das decisões estratégicas junto a Produto e Design e terá autonomia para propor e construir soluções.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir serviços backend utilizando Node.js, Java e Python
  • Desenhar e sustentar soluções utilizando APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Participar de decisões arquiteturais avaliando trade-offs entre escalabilidade, performance e velocidade de entrega
  • Desenvolver e manter interfaces em ReactJS e TypeScript integradas aos serviços de backend
  • Realizar code reviews construtivos e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) menos experientes
  • Garantir boas práticas de engenharia: código limpo, testável, escalável e bem documentado
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua da arquitetura e qualidade dos sistemas

  • Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior com forte atuação em backend
  • Experiência com Node.js, Java ou Python
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes poliglotas e transitar entre diferentes linguagens
  • Experiência com APIs REST e Arquitetura Orientada a Eventos (EDA)
  • Experiência com ReactJS e TypeScript no desenvolvimento de interfaces
  • Domínio de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais
  • Experiência com Docker, Git e pipelines de CI/CD
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas considerando trade-offs de produto e arquitetura

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (CA tools specialist)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (CA/Broadcom tols) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Experience with CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Experience with CA FAVER, CA Allocate (installation, configuration, training).
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX programs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Experience with IBM storage tools .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.
