A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

• Desenho de soluções: Elaborar diagramas e arquiteturas em nuvem garantindo alta disponibilidade, resiliência e SLA mínimo de 99,9%.

• Migração para cloud: Liderar estratégias de lift and shift, replatform ou refactoring de ambientes on-premise para Google Cloud.

• Governança: Definir e implementar padrões de nomenclatura, estrutura de tags, controle de acessos e políticas de segurança para todo o ambiente.

• Otimização de custos (FinOps): Realizar análises recorrentes de consumo, identificando oportunidades de redução de custos e eliminação de desperdícios.


Experiência :

• Domínio dos core services do Google Cloud: Experiência avançada com Compute Engine, GKE (Google Kubernetes Engine), Cloud Run e VPC Networking.

• Dados & Analytics: Vivência com BigQuery, Pub/Sub e Dataflow em arquiteturas orientadas a eventos e altamente escaláveis.

• Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Forte atuação com Terraform (preferencialmente) ou Google Cloud Deployment Manager.

• Segurança & IAM: Implementação de políticas de least privilege, gestão de identidades (Cloud Identity) e utilização de Shared VPC.

• FinOps: Capacidade de monitorar, analisar e otimizar custos utilizando Google Cloud Billing e Recommender.

• Mentoria técnica: Atuação no desenvolvimento e evolução técnica de engenheiros e desenvolvedores.

• Inglês (nível avançado/ótima conversação)


Diferencial:

• Certificação Google Professional Cloud Architect (altamente recomendada) ou Professional Data Engineer.

• Experiência com ambientes multicloud ou híbridos, utilizando Anthos.

• Implementação de pipelines de CI/CD com Cloud Build, GitHub Actions ou GitLab CI.


Celebramos a troca, relações e o poder do contato. Regime Híbrido

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Custumer Care
description:
Sobre a empresa:

  • Empresa multinacional do setor Financeiro até Logística para marcas de consumo nos EUA e na UE.


O que você irá fazer:

  • Resolver chamados de clientes dentro do SLA.
  • Apoiar clientes nas demandas diárias sobre nível de serviço.
  • Identificar falhas de comunicação e visibilidade, reportando ao time.
  • Analisar relatórios do Power BI e sistemas para suporte às demandas.
  • Atuar junto a parceiros internos e logísticos para solução de problemas.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Inglês fluente.
  • Perfil proativo, orientado a soluções e escalabilidade.
  • Experiência mínima de 2 anos em atendimento ao cliente e/ou supply chain.
  • Interesse em atuar com múltiplos clientes e mercados internacionais.
  • Forte organização, comunicação e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Conhecimento em logística, last mile e varejo dos EUA (diferencial).
  • Capacidade de priorização e adaptação em ambientes dinâmicos.


Observações:

  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Tipo de contrato: PJ

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
• Sobre a DevSquad

Somos a DevSquad — uma empresa 100% remota, ágil, formada por profissionais de tecnologia talentosos. Estamos contratando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior para atuar em nossa plataforma de assinatura digital, construída com React, Node.js e AWS Serverless.


Responsabilidades


• Desenvolver novas funcionalidades e aplicações usando React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js e Serverless Framework

• Construir e manter infraestrutura serverless na AWS: Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SES, IAM

• Projetar e implementar serviços backend escaláveis com arquitetura multi-tenant

• Corrigir bugs e resolver incidentes em produção

• Eliminar dívida técnica e melhorar a qualidade do código em todo o stack

• Participar da criação de frameworks internos e ferramentas para desenvolvedores

• Colaborar com QA, UX e produto na entrega de funcionalidades

• Escrever testes e manter uma mentalidade de qualidade em todas as entregas


Requisitos Técnicos


• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência como Engenheiro(a) de Software

• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência com Node.js

• Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência com React

• Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência com AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, SES, IAM)

• Mínimo de 2 anos de experiência com Serverless Framework

• Experiência sólida com Tailwind CSS e ferramentas modernas de frontend

• Experiência comprovada com Git e Docker

• Mentalidade de testes — unitários, integração e E2E

• Experiência com Java é um diferencial

• Experiência com Claude Code / desenvolvimento assistido por IA é um diferencial


Requisitos Comportamentais


• Boa comunicação — clara, objetiva, assíncrona

• Autodidata — aprendizado contínuo de novas tecnologias

• Autogerenciável — dono(a) da sua agenda e das suas entregas

• Paixão por eliminar dívida técnica

• Praticante de DevOps e Agile


Benefícios


• Flexibilidade total: trabalhe de qualquer lugar, a qualquer hora

title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: SAP RE-FX & ARO Consultant (Senior) | S/4HANA | Remote
description:
Oportunidade SAP Internacional | 100% Remoto


Senior SAP RE-FX & ARO Consultant


Se você tem experiência com SAP RE-FX (Flexible Real Estate Management) e Asset Retirement Obligation (ARO) e busca atuar em um ambiente internacional, essa oportunidade pode ser para você.


Modelo de atuação: 100% remoto

Contratação: PJ

Duração: 12 meses (grandes chances de extensão)

Idioma: Inglês avançado / fluente

Horário: 11h às 20h (CST)


O que você irá fazer?


Configurar e suportar SAP RE-FX (Flexible Real Estate Management)

Gerenciar ciclo de vida de contratos imobiliários

Trabalhar com Lease Accounting (IFRS 16 / ASC 842)

Integrar processos com SAP FI, CO e Asset Accounting (FI-AA)

Atuar na configuração e suporte de Asset Retirement Obligation (ARO)

Participar de levantamento de requisitos, testes, go-live e suporte AMS

Resolver incidentes e melhorar continuamente os processos SAP


Requisitos


✔ Experiência sólida com SAP RE-FX

✔ Experiência com ARO (Asset Retirement Obligation)

✔ Conhecimento em SAP FI – FI-AA e FI-GL

✔ Experiência com SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA

✔ Experiência em cenários de integração entre módulos SAP

✔ Inglês avançado ou fluente


Diferenciais

➕ Experiência com IFRS 16 / ASC 842

➕ Experiência com S/4HANA Finance

➕ Conhecimento funcional em enhancements ou debugging SAP

➕ Experiência em consultoria ou ambientes multi-cliente

➕ Experiência em indústrias como energia, utilities ou manufatura

title: Senior Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Senior Developer (Palantir/Pyspark) who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will:

English fluently ,Palantir Foundry, Typescript, React JS, Workshop, Pyspark


And much better if you stand out for:

  • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.
  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Support Palantir Foundry Application Development by designing and developing full stack applications
  • Work on both frontend and backend components to ensure seamless integration and functionality.
  • Improve application User Interface and visualization design
  • Implement operational applications using Foundry Tools (Workshop, Quiver, and Slate).
  • Develop interactive workflow UIs and build/access data versions within the tool for analytics.
  • Develop writeback functionality into the tool as needed.
  • Implement data visualizations using Foundry Tools (Quiver and Contour) and/or Power BI.
  • Maintain applications as usage grows and requirements changeDevelop data pipelines using PySpark to create datasets, Foundry objects, and User Interface applications.
  • Collaborate with the Data Engineering Team to understand the ontology and data pipelines supporting the applications.
  • Support end-to-end data pipeline development using Python and PySpark for ETL processes.
  • Support designing and building high-scale data-intensive workflows.
  • Perform data validations and analysis, using PyTest to create and implement unit tests.
  • Implement Foundry Expectations within Foundry Health checks for automated validations.
  • Monitor and debug critical issues such as data staleness or data quality.
  • Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests to ensure software quality.
  • Debug and resolve issues reported by users or identified through testing


Key Words:

  • Palantir

title: Pessoa Especialista de Dados e DevOps
description:
Sobre a vaga:

A Dimensa está no topo do jogo quando o assunto é tecnologia e infraestrutura para operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros. Nossos sistemas são super escaláveis e adaptáveis, perfeitos para negócios de todos os tamanhos. Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

Nossa equipe de experts vive e respira o setor financeiro, atualizando nossas soluções constantemente para tornar suas operações mais digitais, melhorar a performance, inovar no atendimento aos clientes e garantir que todas as exigências regulatórias sejam 100% cumpridas.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são inclusivas e abertas para pessoas com deficiência.


O DESAFIO:

  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar pipelines de CI/CD para entrega contínua de aplicações com qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar o provisionamento e configuração de ambientes utilizando Infraestrutura como Código (IaC).
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com desenvolvedores, SREs e engenheiros de plataforma para garantir confiabilidade e eficiência no ciclo de vida das aplicações.
  • Integrar validações de segurança e qualidade (DevSecOps) nos pipelines de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de GitOps, automação de deploys e rollback seguro.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de observabilidade, garantindo que logs, métricas e alertas estejam integrados ao fluxo de entrega.
  • Automatizar operações relacionadas a bancos de dados, como migrations, versionamento e sincronização entre ambientes.
  • Atuar em conjunto com o time de DBA para garantir que as mudanças em dados sejam seguras, rastreáveis e padronizadas.
  • Colaborar na evolução das plataformas de containers (ex: Kubernetes, OpenShift), otimizando deploys e escalabilidade.
  • Promover cultura DevOps entre os times, disseminando boas práticas de colaboração e automação.


O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA:

  • Pipelines de CI/CD: GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Tekton, ou equivalentes.
  • Infraestrutura como Código: Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi.
  • Contêineres e Orquestração: Docker, Kubernetes (EKS, GKE, AKS).
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, Datadog.
  • Versionamento e Gestão de Código: Git, GitOps.
  • Automação de Banco de Dados: ferramentas como Liquibase, Flyway, Alembic.
  • Cloud Pública: AWS, Azure ou GCP.
  • Linguagens de automação: Python, Bash, Go (desejável).
  • Segurança em pipelines: integração de SAST, DAST, IaC scanning.


O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ:

️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível)

Assistência Médica

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior – Oracle Cloud
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em arquitetura, integração e processamento de dados na Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em uma arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Prata e Ouro, , integrando fontes heterogêneas — incluindo Oracle Fusion Analytics, APIs, Bancos de Dados e plataformas diversas — garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes Oracle Cloud, com foco em Oracle Cloud Data Integration e Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).

- Construir e gerenciar integrações de dados via APIs REST e ingestão de arquivos (CSV, JSON, XML, Parquet) a partir de fontes heterogêneas.

- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.

- Modelar e estruturar dados nas camadas analíticas para suportar soluções de BI e relatórios analíticos em Power BI.

- Trabalhar com processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT) respeitando a arquitetura de camadas do Data Lake.

- Apoiar a construção e manutenção do Catálogo de Dados no OCI, incluindo descoberta, linhagem e glossário.

- Garantir boas práticas de governança, qualidade e segurança de dados.

- Atuar em colaboração com times de arquitetura, analytics e áreas de negócio para entender demandas e propor soluções escaláveis.


Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.

- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.

- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.

- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).

- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).

- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.

- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar).


Diferenciais:

- Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.

- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.

- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.

- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados.


Modelo de Trabalho

- Remoto

- Contratação PJ


Benefícios ATRA:

- TotalPass

- Reembolso 100% em certificações

- Parcerias educacionais

- Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas

- Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: Desenvolvedor Back-End
description:
Sobre a Oportunidade

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Nível: Pleno ou sênior


Tecnologias e experiências:

Desenvolvimento de APIs REST;

TypeScript e Node.js;

NestJS e WebSocket;

Integração com bancos de dados SQL e ORMs;

PostgreSQL e TypeORM;

Arquitetura de software e Clean Architecture;

Experiência com AWS, GCloud ou Azure (serverless ou instâncias);

Conhecimentos em segurança da informação (detecção de ameaças, etc.);

Certificações e/ou graduação na área.

title: L3 Support Engineer
description:
Job Title: L3 Support Engineer (Linux / Kubernetes / OpenShift / OpenStack)

Location: Remote


Job Summary:

Looking for an L3 Support Engineer with strong expertise in Linux and hands-on experience in Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack . This role focuses on advanced troubleshooting, system stability, and supporting critical infrastructure in a fast-paced production environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide L3 production support for Linux-based systems and cloud/container platforms.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to Kubernetes, OpenShift, and OpenStack environments.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes for recurring incidents.
  • Monitor system performance, availability, and reliability, ensuring minimal downtime .
  • Collaborate with L1/L2 support, DevOps, and engineering teams for issue resolution and improvements.
  • Support incident management, problem management, and change management processes.
  • Work on patching, upgrades, and system maintenance activities.
  • Automate repetitive tasks using shell scripting or other tools .
  • Maintain documentation for issues, solutions, and system configurations .

Required Skills:

  • Strong hands-on experience with Linux (mandatory) .
  • Experience with Kubernetes (deployment, troubleshooting, cluster management).
  • Working knowledge of OpenShift and OpenStack platforms.
  • Experience in production support (L3 level) with incident handling.
  • Good understanding of networking, storage, and system performance tuning .
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools and log analysis .
  • Scripting experience (Bash/Shell/Python is a plus).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP) .
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices .
  • Certifications in Linux, Kubernetes, or OpenStack are a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Ability to work under pressure in critical production environments .
  • Good communication and collaboration skills.

title: Assessor de investimentos
description:
ASSESSOR DE INVESTIMENTOS (AAI) – ANCORD OBRIGATÓRIA | PROSPECÇÃO ATIVA | MODELO 100% REMOTO


Somos um escritório contratado do banco BTG Pactual, o maior banco de Investimentos da América Latina!


Somos focados em trazer proximidade e personalização de serviços, sempre visando melhor atender os objetivos financeiros dos nossos clientes.


Como parte dos nossos planos de expansão, estamos em busca de novos Assessores de Investimentos em todo o território nacional.


Nossa cultura organizacional valoriza a autonomia, o acompanhamento e a flexibilidade para os vinculados.


Oferecemos um modelo de trabalho completamente remoto, utilizando a tecnologia a nosso favor, a fim de promover agilidade, acessibilidade e qualidade de vida para todos os envolvidos em nossos planos de negócios!


Somos intrinsecamente vinculados ao campo da Educação, com parcerias importantes neste setor, a fim de promover aprimoramento crescente de nossos serviços e da carreira dos nossos associados.


Aqui você irá encontrar um ambiente leve e colaborativo, pois acreditamos que é esta a ética de trabalho que nos leva a qualidade e excelência em serviços financeiros!




Sobre o Cargo


  • Ofertar assessoria de investimentos personalizada, com foco na confiança e assertividade;
  • Oferecer serviços, estratégias e os melhores caminhos para atender as necessidades especificas de cada cliente;
  • Estar sempre atualizado sobre as tendências de mercado, a nível regional, nacional e internacional;
  • Realizar análises assertivas e contextualizadas com perfil do investidor;
  • Trabalhar com leads estratégicos e com a prospecção de clientes em potencial;
  • Tornar-se especialista no portfólio do BTG Pactual, produzindo os melhores resultados a nível pessoal e coletivo do escritório.



Requisitos


  • Possuir a certificação ANCORD ativa (indispensável);
  • Ter conhecimentos sobre Mercado Financeiro, Investimentos e desejo de se aprimorar;
  • Ter interesses e habilidades comerciais;
  • Ter interesse em prospectar potenciais investidores;
  • Desejar um modelo de trabalho remoto, alinhado com uma visão de negócios e identidade organizacional moderna e digital;
  • Motivação de crescer e alavancar ganhos!
  • Ser autônomo, movido por desafios e capaz de colaborar para objetivos comuns!
  • Possuir excelentes habilidades comunicacionais.



Modelo de Contratação


  • O assessor se vincula ao escritório no modelo de sociedade;
  • É articulado um percentual de repasses competitivo, passível de evolução e pensado de acordo com a bagagem do assessor;
  • Apoio no processo de transição de carreira e de entrada no mercado, contanto com acompanhamento próximo e valor de suporte (mínimo garantido mensal) com duração de 6 meses.



Etapas de Seleção


  • Entrevista com o Recrutamento e seleção;
  • Entrevista com Sócios;
  • Processo de Compliance.

title: Back-End Developer (.Net / C#)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Back-End Developer with 5+ years of experience and strong expertise in .NET and C#. This role focuses on ingesting and transforming data from multiple sources, running data validations, and ensuring high data quality across ETL pipelines and backend services. The ideal candidate has experience with APIs, legacy data migrations, and AWS-based data environments. Experience with ECS Fargate, SQS, Kinesis, Firehose, S3, and Apache Iceberg is a plus.

This project has a 3-6 month duration with a possibility for long-term engagement.

Our client is a leading energy technology company focused on digitizing fuel operations through a single, real-time platform. Their software connects people, equipment, and facilities to provide enterprise-wide visibility and data-driven insights that fuel asset optimization, improve operational efficiency, and help organizations manage risk, maintenance, and fuel logistics more effectively.

Responsibilities


  • Receive and process raw data from multiple internal and legacy systems.
  • Design and implement data transformation pipelines that convert incoming data into standardized formats.
  • Develop and maintain .NET / C# services and APIs used for data ingestion and transformation.
  • Build and execute data validation and quality checks to ensure the reliability and accuracy of data pipelines.
  • Support ETL processes, including exporting data from legacy systems and integrating it into modern platforms.
  • Work closely with existing engineers responsible for data migration and integration efforts.
  • Act as a data quality advocate, focusing on validating and testing data flows rather than application UI or front-end functionality.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering and data teams to improve data consistency, validation processes, and pipeline stability.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and teamwork skills
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or data engineering roles.
  • Strong experience with .NET and C# development.
  • Experience developing APIs and backend services.
  • Hands-on experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and data transformation.
  • Experience implementing data validation and data quality checks.
  • Experience integrating data from multiple systems or legacy platforms.
  • Familiarity with AWS-based data infrastructure and services.


Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Python for data processing or scripting.
  • Experience working with Apache Iceberg tables for data lake management.
  • Experience with AWS data and streaming services, such as:
  • Amazon ECS Fargate
  • Amazon SQS
  • Amazon Kinesis
  • Amazon Kinesis Firehose
  • Amazon S3


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Recruiter (Fluent English)
description:
Recruiter - Fluent in English | Remote


At Bluedot BPO Solutions, we connect top LATAM talent with high-performing U.S. teams. We are looking for an experienced and strategic Executive Recruiter to lead end-to-end hiring processes and support corporate talent acquisition for international clients.

This fully remote role offers daily exposure to the U.S. market and a clear growth path for professionals who want to build a long-term career in Talent Acquisition and HR leadership.


What We Offer


  • Fixed compensation of R$5,000 + bonuses in USD
  • 100% remote, working directly with U.S. teams
  • Monday to Friday, 12PM – 21 PM (BRT)
  • Long-term position
  • Fast-track growth opportunities (Senior Recruiter, Lead, Manager)
  • International exposure and multicultural environment
  • Structured training and continuous coaching


Your Responsibilities


  • Manage full-cycle recruitment for corporate and strategic roles
  • Partner with stakeholders to align candidate profiles and hiring needs
  • Source, screen, and interview candidates for the U.S. market
  • Utilize tools such as LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms
  • Manage and maintain healthy candidate pipelines
  • Ensure an excellent candidate experience end-to-end
  • Maintain consistent communication with hiring managers and candidates
  • Support strategic hiring initiatives for clients and internal teams


What We’re Looking For


  • 2+ years of experience with Hunting in the North-American Market
  • Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment
  • Strong English communication skills (professional level)
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple requisitions
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and delivery-focused
  • Comfortable in fast-paced environments


Nice to Have


  • Background in corporate or executive recruitment
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, Dynamics, or other ATS
  • Experience in high-volume or fast-paced hiring environments
  • Experience working with global stakeholders
  • Experience recruiting for international or U.S. clients is a strong plus



Technical Requirements


  • Two monitors
  • Laptop with i5/i7 (or equivalent) + 12GB RAM
  • High-speed internet
  • Headset with microphone
  • Quiet home office


Build your international career in Recruitment.


Work directly with U.S. teams and grow in a structured, high-performance environment.

title: Graphic Designer/Carousel Creator (Canva focused)
description:
Job Title: Creative Designer (Canva & Video Content)


Type: Remote | Part-Time (20 hours/week; 4 hours/day)


Client: Fast-growing DTC Beauty & Wellness Brand focused on premium skincare, longevity, and lifestyle content, with a strong community of women interested in science-backed skincare and wellness.


Overview

We are looking for a Creative Designer to support a content-driven personal brand by creating visually engaging social media assets. This role focuses on designing carousel content using Canva and assisting with light video editing.


You will work closely with the founders to translate ideas, references, and written content (e.g., Google Docs or sample carousels) into polished visuals that align with the brand’s style.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design social media carousel posts using Canva based on provided content or references
  • Translate Google Docs or example content into visually consistent, on-brand designs
  • Replicate and adapt existing carousel styles to match the brand’s visual identity
  • Assist with basic video editing for social media content
  • Collaborate with the team to ensure designs align with the intended messaging and style
  • Maintain consistency in layout, formatting, and overall visual presentation


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Canva for creating social media content
  • Strong sense of visual design, layout, and consistency
  • Ability to follow brand style and replicate design references accurately
  • Comfortable working with content provided in documents (e.g., Google Docs) and turning it into visuals
  • Video editing skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Figma or other advanced design tools (nice to have)


Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Detail-oriented with strong execution skills
  • Able to take direction and translate ideas into clean, engaging designs
  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, feedback-driven environment
  • Interested in content creation and visual storytelling

title: Technical Lead
description:
Project Description:

  • The Anaplan Technical Lead is an experienced multi-skilled professional with hands-on experience in Anaplan model development/Support experience. He/she is a good team player who is part of a team responsible for delivering end-to-end application development and Operations Support.


Responsibilities:

  • • Troubleshoot and provide solutions, Root Cause Analysis for incidents raised by business users/L1 team.
  • • Troubleshoot issues related to application access, process, scripts, etc.
  • • Handles Anaplan planned downtimes individually.
  • • In case of incident with a product quality issue, ensure PR is created and tagged against the incident before closing it.
  • • Perform UAT testing for projects owned by operations like new market adoption, simple logic change, etc.
  • • Prepare, present changes in change advisory board and own production implementation.
  • • Coordinate and manage discussions with other support teams and business users.
  • • Effectively communicate with stakeholders and business users.
  • • Think creatively to solve the user problem with a holistic and simple solution.
  • • Drive best practices within teams with respect to operations standards and guidelines.
  • • Ability to learn and adapt to new frameworks/technologies.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • • Should have strong knowledge of Anaplan Connect, ALM Sync, NUX and Cloudworks.
  • • Anaplan Professional Model Builder / Professional Solution Architect Certified.
  • • Should have strong knowledge of troubleshooting and resolving incidents raised by business users and L1 Support.
  • • Good knowledge of troubleshooting and fixing job execution failures.
  • • Ability to analyse /root cause the PRs created for the Anaplan support models.
  • • Prior work experience in Anaplan Support projects.
  • Availability to work in US Central Time
  • Availability to regularly travel to St. Louis
  • • Good communication skills.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • • Basic knowledge of Cloud Services
  • • Knowledge in SRE, ITIL, AgileOps
  • • Able to work independently and interact with the business community, L3 team to come up with solutions.
  • • Knowledge of testing tools like Playwright / Selenium.

title: Data Analyst - Senior
description:
Opportunity – Data Analyst (Senior) | Brazil | Remote


Hi everyone,

I’m currently looking for a Data Analyst (Senior level) to join a global project supporting a leading multinational company.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of data, business, and strategy, turning complex datasets into meaningful insights for decision-making.


What we’re looking for:

  • Strong experience in data analysis / business analytics (5+ years)
  • Advanced skills in SQL
  • Experience with Python (or similar)
  • Solid experience with Power BI (or other BI tools)
  • Experience building dashboards, reports, and performance analyses
  • Ability to work with stakeholders and translate data into insights
  • Fluent English (mandatory)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with financial or performance analytics
  • Knowledge of forecasting / statistical modeling
  • Exposure to AWS, Airflow, Spark or similar tools
  • Experience in global / cross-functional environments


Details:

  • Location: Brazil (Remote)
  • Type: Contract
  • Work setup: Home-based
  • Schedule: Full-time

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is redefining productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. Thanks to our flexible, distributed model of global operation and the high caliber of our experts, we have enjoyed triple digit growth over the past five years, creating amazing career opportunities for our people.


If you want to accelerate your career working with like-minded subject matter experts, solving interesting problems and building the products of tomorrow, this opportunity is for you.


We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go (Golang) expertise and hands-on experience building secure, high-throughput systems in crypto, blockchain, or financial domains.

This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, cryptography, and regulated financial infrastructure, contributing to mission-critical platforms that process high-value transactions at scale.


The impact you'll make:


  • Design, implement, and maintain high-availability backend services using Go (Golang).
  • Build and evolve crypto-native systems, including wallets, custody services, transaction pipelines, and blockchain integrations.
  • Develop secure APIs and internal services that handle sensitive financial and cryptographic operations.
  • Collaborate with product and architecture teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Optimize systems for performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed environments.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and production incident resolution.
  • Ensure compliance with security, auditability, and regulatory requirements typical of financial and crypto platforms.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment strategies.
  • Act as a technical advisor within the engagement, supporting best practices and engineering excellence


Technology Stack:


  • Go (Golang)
  • Blockchain


What you'll bring to us:


  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on Go.
  • Prior exposure to crypto, fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure is highly preferred.
  • Experience working in consulting, staff augmentation, or cross-team delivery models is a plus.
  • Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
  • Strong communication skills in English, able to explain complex technical topics to mixed audiences.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a delivery-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements.
  • Ability to balance client needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Desirable experience with Hashing (SHA-256, Keccak), Digital signatures (ECDSA, EdDSA), Go crypto libraries, Blockchain.
  • Required to be located in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro.



Some of the benefits you’ll enjoy working with us:


  • The chance to work in innovative projects with leading brands, that use the latest technologies that fuel transformation.
  • The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
  • A flexible and remote working environment.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
This position offers you the opportunity to join a fast-growing technology organization that is redefining productivity paradigms in the software engineering industry. Thanks to our flexible, distributed model of global operation and the high caliber of our experts, we have enjoyed triple digit growth over the past five years, creating amazing career opportunities for our people.


If you want to accelerate your career working with like-minded subject matter experts, solving interesting problems and building the products of tomorrow, this opportunity is for you.


We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer with strong Go (Golang) expertise and hands-on experience building secure, high-throughput systems in crypto, blockchain, or financial domains.

This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, cryptography, and regulated financial infrastructure, contributing to mission-critical platforms that process high-value transactions at scale.


The impact you'll make:


  • Design, implement, and maintain high-availability backend services using Go (Golang).
  • Build and evolve crypto-native systems, including wallets, custody services, transaction pipelines, and blockchain integrations.
  • Develop secure APIs and internal services that handle sensitive financial and cryptographic operations.
  • Collaborate with product and architecture teams to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Optimize systems for performance, reliability, and fault tolerance in distributed environments.
  • Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and production incident resolution.
  • Ensure compliance with security, auditability, and regulatory requirements typical of financial and crypto platforms.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment strategies.
  • Act as a technical advisor within the engagement, supporting best practices and engineering excellence


Technology Stack:


  • Go (Golang)
  • Blockchain


What you'll bring to us:


  • 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with a strong focus on Go.
  • Prior exposure to crypto, fintech, payments, or financial infrastructure is highly preferred.
  • Experience working in consulting, staff augmentation, or cross-team delivery models is a plus.
  • Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively with distributed teams.
  • Strong communication skills in English, able to explain complex technical topics to mixed audiences.
  • Pragmatic problem-solver with a delivery-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with evolving requirements.
  • Ability to balance client needs, technical quality, and delivery timelines.
  • Desirable experience with Hashing (SHA-256, Keccak), Digital signatures (ECDSA, EdDSA), Go crypto libraries, Blockchain.
  • Required to be located in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro.



Some of the benefits you’ll enjoy working with us:


  • The chance to work in innovative projects with leading brands, that use the latest technologies that fuel transformation.
  • The opportunity to be part of an amazing, multicultural community of tech experts.
  • A flexible and remote working environment.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Node Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Backend Sênior com foco em Node.js , que tenha forte experiência em construção de APIs, integração entre sistemas e arquitetura de aplicações escaláveis. Essa pessoa terá papel importante tanto no desenvolvimento quanto na definição de boas práticas técnicas junto ao time.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e evoluir backends escaláveis , incluindo APIs, scripts, jobs e processos de carga de dados.
  • Atuar na integração entre sistemas , utilizando REST APIs, SOAP e outros formatos de comunicação.
  • Contribuir para a definição de arquitetura e decisões técnicas , apoiando na escolha de tecnologias, frameworks e padrões.
  • Garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais .
  • Colaborar com o time na organização do backlog técnico e evolução da arquitetura das aplicações .
  • Participar da definição de MVPs e evolução progressiva das soluções , equilibrando qualidade técnica e prazos de entrega.
  • Atuar em colaboração com outras áreas e clientes, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas eficientes .


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Node.js .
  • Experiência na construção de APIs e integração entre sistemas (REST, SOAP, troca de arquivos).
  • Conhecimento em modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Vivência com arquitetura de microsserviços, mensageria e Design Patterns .
  • Experiência com práticas de DevOps , utilizando ferramentas como Docker, Kubernetes, Git e pipelines de CI/CD.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes com arquiteturas distribuídas e sistemas de alta escala .

title: Business Analyst Salesforce - 131517
description:
O que buscamos:

Profissional que atue com (Business Analyst Salesforce).

Responsabilidades:

Esteira de Melhoria de Service Cloud e Digital Engagement atendendo implementações legadas.

O Salesforce Business Analyst será responsável por conduzir o levantamento, análise e detalhamento de requisitos de negócio para soluções na plataforma Salesforce, com foco em Service Cloud e Digital Engagement.

Atua como ponte estratégica entre negócio, tecnologia e times de desenvolvimento, garantindo que os requisitos sejam claros, priorizados e traduzidos em soluções aderentes às necessidades do cliente.

  • Conduzir workshops de discovery e levantamento de requisitos com stakeholders;
  • Elaborar requisitos funcionais, histórias de usuário e documentação funcional;
  • Definir critérios de aceite claros e testáveis;
  • Atuar na tradução das necessidades de negócio para soluções na plataforma Salesforce;
  • Participar da definição de soluções funcionais em Service Cloud;
  • Apoiar a implementação de Digital Engagement (Chat, WhatsApp e Bots);
  • Definir e documentar regras de Omni-Channel Routing, filas, SLAs e roteamento;
  • Elaborar modelagem de dados funcional (objetos, campos e relacionamentos);
  • Apoiar o time na priorização do backlog e refinamento das histórias;
  • Atuar em cerimônias ágeis (Sprint Planning, Refinement, Review e Retrospective);
  • Apoiar testes funcionais e validação das entregas junto ao negócio.

Requisitos :

  • Experiência como Business Analyst em projetos Salesforce;
  • Conhecimento em Salesforce Service Cloud;
  • Experiência com Digital Engagement;
  • Experiência em escrita de requisitos funcionais e histórias de usuário;
  • Definição de critérios de aceite;
  • Conhecimento de modelagem de dados básica (objetos, campos e relacionamentos);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban).

Diferencial:

  • Experiência com Omni-Channel, filas, SLAs e roteamento;
  • Experiência em projetos de atendimento ao cliente ou contact center;
  • Certificações Salesforce (ex.: Salesforce Administrator ou Service Cloud Consultant);
  • Ingles Técnico: Desejável, mas não obrigatório.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Data Engineer Revenue Management
description:
Data Engineer Revenue Management Remote (send your resume in English)


A Iron Mountain está em busca de um Data Engineer Revenue Management motivado(a) e com fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês para se juntar à nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management (Gestão de Receita Global).

Neste cargo, você será responsável por projetar, implementar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis para garantir dados limpos e acessíveis, transformando dados brutos em insights que impulsionam a melhor segmentação de clientes.

Você fará parte de uma equipe de alto impacto dedicada a direcionar a estratégia de preços global para atingir nossas metas de receita e lucro, exigindo coordenação entre as regiões da América do Norte, Europa e América Latina.


O Que Você Fará

  • Desenvolver Arquiteturas de Dados Escaláveis: Projetar e manter pipelines de Extraction, Transformation, and Loading (Extração, Transformação e Carregamento - ETL) integrando dados de sistemas operacionais globais usando tecnologias Amazon Web Services (AWS) e Structured Query Language (SQL).
  • Otimizar Processos e Automação: Identificar e implementar melhorias nos processos internos, redesenhando a infraestrutura para maior escalabilidade e automatizando processos manuais para fornecer conjuntos de dados selecionados para análises e painéis operacionais.
  • Garantir a Excelência Operacional e Governança: Monitorar o desempenho e a qualidade dos pipelines, implementando testes automatizados e padrões de governança de dados alinhados às políticas de segurança da informação da empresa.


O candidato ideal terá:

  • fluência/nível avançado no idioma inglês
  • 3 a 5 anos ou mais de experiência em engenharia de dados, com foco em construção de pipelines em ambientes corporativos de grande escala.
  • Sólido conhecimento técnico em modelagem de dados, Structured Query Language (SQL) e proficiência em linguagens de programação como Python ou Scala.
  • Capacidade comprovada em processamento de dados distribuídos (ex: Spark) e no uso de plataformas em nuvem para extração e carregamento de conjuntos de dados complexos.
  • Bacharelado ou Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou área relacionada.


O Que Oferecemos (Benefícios)

  • Localização: Opções de trabalho remoto ou híbrido para apoiar o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional.
  • Equilíbrio e Bem-Estar: Programa de férias e dias de folga remunerados.
  • Segurança e Futuro: Planos abrangentes de saúde, bem-estar e previdência privada.
  • Desenvolvimento Contínuo: Oportunidades de aprendizado constante e crescimento profissional em uma organização líder global.


Pronto para ajudar a proteger e desbloquear o valor da informação? Candidate-se hoje mesmo para integrar nossa equipe de Global Revenue Management e construir as bases de dados do futuro!

title: Ruby Consultant
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

Long-term contract

Remote

Senior Fullstack Engineer

What You Get To Do Every Day

- Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that directly contributes to company-wide initiatives

- Develop using interesting technologies -- Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

- Have significant input into technical decisions that will shape the future of our software systems

- Learn something new, whether its a new software design pattern or new initiative to push the company forward

- Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to your peers - Pair up with a team member to work together on features

- Deploy user-facing code to production


✅ Skills/Experience

- What You Bring To The Role

- 5+ years professional software development experience - Fluency with either Elixir or Ruby

- Proficient with the latest versions of ECMAScript (JavaScript) as well as HTML and CSS

- Experience with React and common tools used in the wider React ecosystem, such as Node.js and npm

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Enthusiasm for solving problems for our users with technology

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
At Avenue Code, we are passionate about transforming businesses through technology. We are a leading end-to-end development consultancy for digital transformation across various markets, growing sustainably since day one. We believe that great results are born from strong relationships. Our team combines technical expertise, collaboration, and a welcoming approach to work that makes all the difference.


About The Opportunity


We are looking for a Salesforce Developer to join a team responsible for evolving and optimizing a Salesforce Service Cloud environment. In this role, you will collaborate with Salesforce engineers, administrators, and business stakeholders to design, develop, and deploy solutions that improve operational processes and platform adoption. You will work with both declarative configurations and custom development to support Customer Experience initiatives and scalable Salesforce capabilities.


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement solutions using Salesforce Service Cloud, leveraging both declarative features and custom development.
  • Develop custom functionality using Apex, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Configure, enhance, and maintain standard and custom Salesforce capabilities to support the CX team, including custom objects, workflows, Process Builder, Lightning Flows, sharing rules, email alerts, quick actions, and Embedded Service chat deployments.
  • Support integrations, platform enhancements, and new feature development.
  • Manage code deployments across multiple environments.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support business insights.
  • Contribute to the documentation of Salesforce configurations and integrations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions for customer experience operations.


Required Qualifications


  • Strong experience working with Salesforce development and configuration.
  • Proficiency with Apex, JavaScript, SOQL, SOSL, Lightning Components, and Lightning Web Components.
  • Experience working with Salesforce automation tools, reporting, and dashboards.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to work effectively in collaborative environments with tight timelines.
  • Background in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.


Nice To Have Skills


  • Experience supporting customer experience (CX) or service operations teams.
  • Familiarity with community portals or help center implementations.
  • Salesforce certifications.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend Sênior (Databricks)
description:
stamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend com foco em Databricks para atuar em um projeto internacional de alta visibilidade, com foco na construção de aplicações modernas e dashboards de dados.

O(a) profissional será responsável por desenvolver aplicações frontend robustas utilizando Node.js e React , garantindo integração eficiente com a plataforma Databricks Apps e suporte a ambientes orientados a dados.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações frontend utilizando React e Node.js
  • Construir aplicações como pacotes deployáveis na plataforma Databricks Apps
  • Desenvolver interfaces para visualização de dados e dashboards interativos
  • Integrar aplicações com serviços e autenticação via Databricks OAuth
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de dados e backend para integração de soluções
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, performance e organização de código
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e colaborar em um ambiente ágil e internacional



Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência com React.js e Node.js
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações frontend integradas a plataformas de dados
  • Conhecimento em Databricks Apps (deploy de aplicações)
  • Conhecimento em OAuth (preferencialmente Databricks OAuth)
  • Experiência com dashboards de dados / data visualization
  • Familiaridade com consumo de APIs e integração frontend-backend
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git)



Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com Databricks
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de dados e analytics
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de visualização (ex: Chart.js, D3.js, Recharts )
  • Experiência no mercado de seguros ou resseguros (re/insurance)



Informações da Vaga

  • Projeto internacional
  • Inglês fluente obrigatório (interação com clientes globais)
  • Modelo: 100% remoto
  • Contratação: PJ

title: Senior Java Developer
description:
About:

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect, design, and implement backend systems and APIs using Java (Spring Boot/Spring Cloud) for AI-driven applications.
  • Collaborate with data science and ML teams to integrate machine learning models and pipelines into scalable backend services.
  • Develop and optimize microservices, ensuring low latency and high availability.
  • Implement data ingestion, transformation, and model-serving workflows in coordination with ML engineers.
  • Ensure seamless deployment of ML models through API endpoints and containerized environments.
  • Apply best practices for security, scalability, and reliability across distributed systems.
  • Optimize backend services for performance and cost efficiency in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and infrastructure as code.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (AI/ML specialization a plus).
  • 7+ years of professional backend development experience with Java.
  • Strong proficiency in Java (8 or higher) and frameworks such as Spring Boot or Spring Cloud .
  • Experience with RESTful API design , microservices architecture , and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
  • Proficient in Git , CI/CD pipelines , and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Understanding of Agile development principles and version control best practices.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with MLOps practices and CI/CD for ML pipelines.
  • Contributions to AI/ML-related open-source projects or research experience.


Benefits

- Full-time remote working within an international environment

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Architect, design, and implement backend systems and APIs using Java (Spring Boot/Spring Cloud) for AI-driven applications.
  • Collaborate with data science and ML teams to integrate machine learning models and pipelines into scalable backend services.
  • Develop and optimize microservices, ensuring low latency and high availability.
  • Implement data ingestion, transformation, and model-serving workflows in coordination with ML engineers.
  • Ensure seamless deployment of ML models through API endpoints and containerized environments.
  • Apply best practices for security, scalability, and reliability across distributed systems.
  • Optimize backend services for performance and cost efficiency in cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and infrastructure as code.

  • Strong proficiency in Java (8 or higher) and frameworks such as Spring Boot or Spring Cloud .
  • Experience with RESTful API design , microservices architecture , and event-driven systems .
  • Solid understanding of SQL/NoSQL databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure.
  • Proficient in Git , CI/CD pipelines , and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes).

title: Remote Healthcare and Social Assistance Expert - 65107
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role overview:

We are looking for healthcare domain experts (5+ years experience) to create real-world, profession-based prompts and tasks. The role involves creating high quality prompts and documents to evaluate model responses on day-to-day work in healthcare, clinical, and administrative settings.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create realistic, first-person prompts based on actual job workflows
  • Design tasks that reflect real-world healthcare and clinical scenarios
  • Select and use relevant public data/documents as input files
  • Ensure prompts are clear, specific, and aligned to the occupation
  • Review tasks for accuracy, completeness, and real-world relevance


Requirements:

  • Degree in Healthcare, Nursing, Administration, Life Sciences, or related field
  • Strong understanding of real-world workflows in your profession
  • Ability to convert work scenarios into structured, high-quality prompts


Who can Apply :

We are open to many experts within healthcare (including but not limited to): Registered Nurses, First-Line Supervisors of Office/Admin Support, Medical & Health Services Managers, Nurse Practitioners, Medical Secretaries & Administrative Assistants.


Terms of Contract :

  • Opportunity is for a project that is ~2 week duration with potential extension


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Architect .


In this role you will:

Lead architecture and delivery of systems that unify OT and IT across SCADA/MES and enterprise platforms. Apply UNS (ISA‑95/88), govern industrial data models, and enable secure, scalable batch/streaming integrations on‑prem and in the cloud.

  • Architect and design end‑to‑end OT→IT data integrations (batch/streaming) from SCADA, MES, Historians to enterprise/cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP); Experience in Azure Event Hubs/Event Grid is a plus.
  • Apply UNS (ISA‑95/88), industrial data modeling, and metadata management; enforce data quality, lineage, governance, and security-by-design.
  • Integrate industrial platforms (Ignition, HiveMQ, HighByte advantageous) via OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus; build/govern RESTful APIs and connectors for SAP, SCADA, MES, LIMS, Historians.
  • Define and socialize application/integration/infrastructure standards, lead architecture for enterprise IT and digital transformation in regulated manufacturing.
  • Deploy/support enterprise applications with reliability, compliance, and operability, design for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
  • Perform schema design and performance tuning across SQL/NoSQL datastores.
  • Produce and maintain clear architecture artifacts (diagrams, process/sequence flows, specifications); provide guidance to cross‑functional delivery teams.


We have some requirements:

  • Bachelor’s in engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in manufacturing or life sciences with OT/IT interoperability; familiarity with GxP, regulated data flows, and enterprise data governance is advantageous.
  • Strong analytical/problem‑solving; structured troubleshooting.
  • Clear communicator with effective stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  • Proactive, detail‑oriented collaborator in agile, cross‑functional environments.
  • Strong analytical/problem‑solving; structured troubleshooting.
  • Clear communicator with effective stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  • Fluent English

title: Graphic Designer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $1,300 - $1,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Graphic Designer focused on email and lifecycle marketing creative  to join their marketing team. In this role, you will own the visual execution of their email, SMS, and promotional campaigns, working closely with retention, marketing, and creative teams to bring campaigns to life.


This is a high-output, performance-driven role. They run a structured weekly marketing calendar with multiple sends across email and SMS, so speed, organization, and strong creative instincts are critical.


What You'll Do:

Email & Lifecycle Creative

  • Design marketing emails across promotional, campaign, and automated lifecycle flows
  • Create assets for email, SMS, landing pages, and retention marketing campaigns
  • Build modular email systems that allow for quick campaign iteration
  • Translate marketing strategy into high-converting email layouts


Campaign Production

  • Execute weekly marketing calendars with multiple sends per week
  • Design creative for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and evergreen flows
  • Collaborate with retention and marketing teams to deliver assets quickly and efficiently
  • Maintain visual consistency across all lifecycle marketing touchpoints


Lifestyle Marketing Creative

  • Design marketing assets using lifestyle photography and brand creative
  • Support marketing campaigns across email, social, and digital placements
  • Help evolve their visual storytelling across campaigns


Optimization & Iteration

  • Work closely with marketing teams to test and improve creative performance
  • Iterate quickly on creative based on campaign results
  • Contribute ideas for new creative concepts and campaign approaches


Their Marketing Workflow:

Their lifecycle marketing operates on a structured weekly campaign calendar, with multiple emails and SMS sends each week. You will work inside this framework by:

  • Designing assets aligned to weekly campaign themes
  • Creating creative that supports multiple sends across a campaign window
  • Building creative that can be reused and iterated on across lifecycle flows
  • They move fast and prioritize clear, high-impact creative that performs, not overly complex designs.


Tools & Experience:

Required

  • Figma
  • Email design systems
  • Experience designing marketing emails
  • Strong understanding of mobile-first design


Nice to Have

  • Klaviyo / Attentive experience
  • Experience with lifecycle marketing
  • Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator)
  • Understanding of e-commerce marketing and DTC brands


What They’re Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer with strong visual design skills, particularly focused on email and marketing content
  • Ability to produce high-quality work quickly
  • Organized and comfortable working inside structured marketing calendars
  • Experience with email marketing and promotional campaigns
  • Understanding of e-commerce and performance marketing


Bonus If You Have:

  • Experience with lifestyle or fashion brands
  • Experience designing for high-volume email marketing programs
  • Motion / light animation for marketing assets


The Type of Designer Who Thrives Here:

Someone who:

  • Moves fast
  • Understands marketing
  • Likes working inside a campaign rhythm
  • Knows that great marketing creative is about clarity and performance, not just aesthetics


Work Schedule: US Pacific Standard Time


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to design high-impact lifecycle marketing campaigns for a fast-paced e-commerce brand.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.
