title: Desenvolvedor Pl. / SR.
description:
Sobre a Lockton

Fundada há mais de 50 anos por Jack Lockton em Kansas City, a Lockton desenvolveu uma marca internacionalmente reconhecida pela qualidade e eficiência nos serviços que oferecemos. Graças a lealdade de nossos clientes, que nos permitiu crescer expressivamente nos últimos anos, a Lockton hoje está entre as maiores corretoras de seguro do mundo, conquistando a taxa de crescimento orgânico mais rápida do mercado de corretoras


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend utilizando .NET e SQL Server.
  • Implementar interfaces e funcionalidades frontend utilizando MudBlazor e Vue.js.
  • Atuar na sustentação e evolução de sistemas críticos em produção, garantindo estabilidade, qualidade e segurança.
  • Participar ativamente do desenho de soluções, evolução arquitetural, definição de padrões, boas práticas e melhorias de performance.
  • Desenvolver e sustentar APIs REST estáveis e escaláveis, seguindo padrões modernos de desenvolvimento e segurança.
  • Contribuir com o ciclo completo de entrega: análise, desenvolvimento, testes, documentação e melhoria contínua.
  • Participar de rituais ágeis e colaborar com o time para entregas previsíveis e de alto valor.
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente de autonomia, propondo melhorias e novas abordagens tecnológicas.
  • Auxiliar na evolução dos pipelines de CI/CD e integrações com Azure (ou cloud similar).


Requisitos e Qualificações:


  • Experiência sólida com .NET Core e/ou .NET Framework em ambientes de missão crítica.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs REST com ASP.NET WebApi .
  • Conhecimento em SQL Server , incluindo modelagem e procedures.
  • Experiência prática com Entity Framework Core , mapeamento e estratégias de otimização.
  • Familiaridade com ASP.NET Identity Core , JWT e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Conhecimento em MudBlazor e integração frontend-backend.
  • Vivência em ambientes de CI/CD , versionamento Git, testes automatizados e pipelines de entrega.
  • Experiência com times ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e comunicação ativa.
  • Desejável: Experiência com Cloud (Azure ou similar) : App Services, Storage, Pipelines, Logs, Monitoramento, etc.

title: Advogado (a) Sênior | Contencioso Cível Estratégico
description:
QUEM SOMOS


TozziniFreire é um escritório full-service com atuação em 55 áreas do Direito Empresarial. Nosso compromisso com a integridade, a responsabilidade social e diversidade e a inclusão social está expresso em nossa missão e é reforçado diariamente em nosso desempenho.


INOVADORES ATÉ PARA INOVAR

Somos pioneiros no desenvolvimento de um programa de inovação interno, o ThinkFuture, que prepara nossos advogados para as transformações digitais e já é referência jurídica nos assuntos que envolvam tecnologia.


NOSSA ATUAÇÃO

Nossa equipe de contencioso cível estratégico é premiada e reconhecida pelo mercado e pelos principais guias nacionais e internacionais. O time tem vasta experiência nos diferentes setores, incluindo Consumidor, Tech Litigation & Data Privacy, em que assessoramos empresas com grandes relevâncias no mercado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Para nós, a diversidade é peça fundamental do sucesso. Buscamos advogadas (os) Seniores, com inglês fluente e experiência na área do Contencioso Cível Estratégico.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Profissionais com experiência na área do Contencioso Cível Estratégico;
  • Graduação Superior Completa em Direito;
  • OAB Ativa;
  • Inglês Fluente.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
Description

We are looking for a highly skilled Principal Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will lead architectural decisions and set standards for how we design, build and maintain our data platform and data-driven systems.

This is a hands-on role with no direct people management, but you will act as a strong technical reference, guiding others and driving initiatives that shape the future of our data ecosystem. You will work across data engineering and personalization use cases, helping transform raw data into actionable insights and intelligent user experiences.



Responsibilities

  • Make architectural and design decisions for our data pipelines and infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance and long-term maintainability.
  • Write production-ready TypeScript code (AWS Lambda, CDK, Zod validation) to support data and backend workflows.
  • Design, build and maintain data pipelines using AWS services and databases such as Aurora, Snowflake and DynamoDB.
  • Develop and optimize ETL/ELT processes to ingest, transform and load data efficiently.
  • Work with vector databases and embeddings to enable semantic search and personalization capabilities.
  • Apply personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation to improve data-driven user experiences.
  • Optimize data models and structures within Snowflake for cost-efficiency and usability.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy and consistency through validation, monitoring and testing practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, analysts and product stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
  • Review code, contribute to architectural discussions and mentor other engineers.
  • Continuously evaluate new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform.



Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles. We are flexible for candidates with strong recent experience in AWS data pipelines and vector embeddings or personalization systems.
  • Strong experience with AWS services, especially Lambda, CDK and data-related infrastructure.
  • Experience writing production TypeScript.
  • Solid knowledge of Snowflake and relational databases such as Aurora or PostgreSQL.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines in cloud environments.
  • Advanced SQL skills.
  • Experience working with vector databases and embeddings for semantic search or similar use cases.
  • Understanding of personalization concepts such as scoring, reranking and segmentation.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Experience with BI tools or big data technologies is a plus.



Profile Requirements

  • Strong technical leadership and ability to make architectural decisions.
  • Comfortable owning complex initiatives end to end.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate cross-functionally.
  • Proactive, hands-on and comfortable in evolving environments.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About the Role

We’re building an AI-driven product and looking for a Full Stack Engineer to join our growing team. You’ll work closely with the founder, product manager, and designer in a hands-on role that suits someone who thrives in fast-moving environments and wants to make a real impact in a small, ambitious team.


Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain end-to-end web applications using React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
  • Collaborate with product and design to deliver high-quality, scalable features.
  • Own the full development lifecycle, from architecture to deployment.
  • Write clean, maintainable code and help define best practices.
  • Evaluate technical tradeoffs and propose efficient solutions.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively in a distributed team.


Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience as a Full Stack Engineer (ideally in startups or small teams).
  • Strong skills in React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with API integrations and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of design principles, Git, and CI/CD.
  • Excellent communication skills in English (C1).
  • Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable working independently.
  • located in Brazil


Nice to Have

  • Experience with AI-related products or APIs.
  • Knowledge of TypeScript or other modern frameworks.
  • Interest in product thinking and user experience.

title: Analista de Growth Pleno — Jornada do Cliente & Conversão (ChatBot WhatsApp)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ


Remoto


A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.


O Papel

O Analista de Growth Pleno será o principal responsável pela jornada do cliente no chatbot do WhatsApp, o maior canal de aquisição e relacionamento da empresa. A missão é clara: reduzir atrito, combater o abandono e maximizar o Lifetime Value (LTV) da base de leads e clientes.


Responsabilidades

  • Mapear e otimizar o funil conversacional de ponta a ponta, identificando gargalos nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups e arquitetura dos fluxos.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios e campanhas de reengajamento.
  • Auxiliar na construção de dashboards de acompanhamento da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados (Snowflake, Power BI).
  • Refinar clusters de audiência para personalização em escala.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com os times de Marketing, Vendas, BI e Produto/Tech.


KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Capacidade técnica de uso ou criação de agentes de IA, independentemente da ferramenta ou framework (Claude, Manus, Antigravity…).
  • Experiência sólida como Analista de Growth, CRO, Lifecycle Marketing, CRM ou Produto, com foco em conversão.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada: métricas de funil, análise de cohort, LTV e CAC.
  • Vivência prática com otimização de chatbots, automação de mensagens e WhatsApp API oficial.
  • Domínio de frameworks de growth hacking e testes A/B.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Boa comunicação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócios.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, mercado de crédito ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Conhecimento na plataforma ColmeIA ou chats conversacionais similares.
  • Habilidades em SQL e ferramentas como Metabase ou Supabase.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização de fluxos conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.


Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.

title: Analista de Growth Pleno — Jornada do Cliente & Conversão (ChatBot WhatsApp)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ


Remoto


A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.


O Papel

O Analista de Growth Pleno será o principal responsável pela jornada do cliente no chatbot do WhatsApp, o maior canal de aquisição e relacionamento da empresa. A missão é clara: reduzir atrito, combater o abandono e maximizar o Lifetime Value (LTV) da base de leads e clientes.


Responsabilidades

  • Mapear e otimizar o funil conversacional de ponta a ponta, identificando gargalos nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups e arquitetura dos fluxos.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios e campanhas de reengajamento.
  • Auxiliar na construção de dashboards de acompanhamento da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados (Snowflake, Power BI).
  • Refinar clusters de audiência para personalização em escala.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com os times de Marketing, Vendas, BI e Produto/Tech.


KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.

  • Capacidade técnica de uso ou criação de agentes de IA, independentemente da ferramenta ou framework (Claude, Manus, Antigravity…).
  • Experiência sólida como Analista de Growth, CRO, Lifecycle Marketing, CRM ou Produto, com foco em conversão.

  • Vivência prática com otimização de chatbots, automação de mensagens e WhatsApp API oficial.

title: Sr. Backend Engineer (Node.js)
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Backend Engineer (Node.js) who thrives in challenging environments and enjoys taking ownership of complex systems to transform them into secure, scalable, and production-ready solutions.


You are highly hands-on and comfortable working with evolving or partially structured codebases. You can quickly assess risks, identify critical issues, and execute remediation strategies under tight timelines. You value clean code, security best practices, and reliable system behavior.


You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, communicate technical challenges clearly, and play a key role in stabilizing applications and restoring confidence in production systems. You are motivated by making a tangible impact and contributing to the successful relaunch and future scalability of a critical platform.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in backend development using Node.js.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong experience working with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Proven experience handling legacy systems, codebase audits, or technical recovery scenarios.
  • Solid understanding of application security best practices, including secure handling of sensitive data.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS environments and services.
  • Experience setting up or troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong experience working with PostgreSQL databases (RDS preferred).
  • Familiarity with proxies, CORS, and common web security vulnerabilities (e.g., SSRF).
  • Ability to work in fast-paced environments with ambiguous or incomplete documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to prioritize issues based on business impact.
  • Experience collaborating with mobile teams (React Native is a plus).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership of the Node.js backend and perform a full technical assessment of the codebase.
  • Identify and remediate critical security vulnerabilities and insecure integrations.
  • Refactor unstable or low-quality code to improve reliability, maintainability, and performance.
  • Stabilize core application flows required for production readiness.
  • Re-establish codebase ownership by organizing and migrating repositories within the client environment.
  • Analyze and restore CI/CD pipelines across repositories and environments.
  • Set up and validate staging environments to support testing and release processes.
  • Audit and stabilize third-party integrations such as payments and external platforms.
  • Collaborate with QA and stakeholders to validate functionality and prioritize fixes.
  • Support release readiness and launch execution ensuring system stability.
  • Enforce a feature-freeze approach focused on stabilization and critical fixes.
  • Contribute to defining a post-launch roadmap to support scalability and future development.
  • Continuously improve system security, performance, and operational stability.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Node.js backend development.
  • Experience working with legacy systems, system stabilization, or technical recovery projects.
  • Strong experience with AWS, CI/CD pipelines, and PostgreSQL.
  • Solid understanding of backend security and API integrations.
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


We Are Engineered Different.


At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Company:

Our client is a leading provider of org chart automation and workforce planning software that empowers HR professionals and the people leaders they support. To support our fast-growing team, we are hiring a Software Support Specialist who enjoys solving problems, helping customers succeed, and working closely with a team that cares deeply about the product and the people who use it.

In this role, you will work directly with customers to help them get the most value out of our client’s SaaS platform. You will troubleshoot issues, guide users through configuration and best practices, and partner with internal teams to improve both the product and the customer experience.

This is a hands-on role in a collaborative team where curiosity, ownership, and a growth mindset are valued. If you enjoy technology, learning new systems, and turning complex problems into clear solutions for customers, you will thrive here.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical support for web-based platform, helping customers resolve issues and use the product effectively
  • Work directly with customers to configure our product and guide them through best practices for importing and managing organizational data
  • Investigate and resolve support tickets with a focus on timely, thoughtful communication and a positive client experience
  • Collaborate with internal teams to escalate and resolve complex issues
  • Identify patterns in support requests and provide feedback that helps improve the product and documentation
  • Contribute to internal knowledge bases and help refine support processes as the company grows


Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of experience supporting web-based applications or SaaS platforms
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to diagnose technical issues clearly and efficiently
  • Comfort working directly with customers and explaining technical concepts in a clear, approachable way
  • Curiosity and a growth mindset, with the ability to quickly learn new technologies and systems
  • Self-motivation and ownership in identifying problems and improving processes
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across teams to find solutions
  • Sound judgment and attention to detail

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Mosaic Puzzles

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.


We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.


Check our website for more information:


Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance tracking .
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

description:
About Mosaic Puzzles

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.


We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.


Check our website for more information:


Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance tracking .
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: ITSM Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for an Ivanti ITSM Specialist to take over the managed support and administration of an existing Ivanti environment. The main goal is to ensure platform stability, manage day-to-day operations, and support the ITSM application while parallel assessments are running.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Administration: Handle day-to-day configuration and maintenance of the Ivanti ITSM platform.
  • Queue Management: Manage incident and request queues, performing triage and ensuring timely resolution.
  • User Management: Administer users, groups, and maintain the service catalog.
  • Reporting: Generate and maintain dashboards and operational reports as needed.
  • Maintenance & Support: Provide minor enhancements and break-fix support to ensure \"nothing stops, nothing breaks.\"
  • Vendor Liaison: Act as the point of contact with Ivanti vendors for technical escalations.

Technical Requirements (Must-haves)

  • Experience: Proven experience administering Ivanti Service Management (ISM) or Ivanti Neurons for ITSM .
  • ITSM Knowledge: Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes (Incident, Request, Change management).
  • Reporting: Ability to run and customize reports within the Ivanti environment.
  • Soft Skills: Proactive \"keep the lights on\" mindset, ability to work independently, and clear communication.

title: Gerente de vendas
description:
A Brunel está em busca de um(a) Sales Manager para atuar junto a um de nossos clientes do setor de Fabricação de produtos químicos. Esta é a função responsável por atingir os objetivos de receita junto à equipe de vendas em nível global, atuando na gestão de equipes, análise de mercado e definição de planos comerciais e de clientes.

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Idioma: Inglês avançado ou fluente.

Duração: Indeterminado

Responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar um plano de vendas internacional e metas (quotas) alinhadas ao plano operacional anual.
  • Gerenciar o desempenho de colaboradores individuais e/ou equipes dedicadas.
  • Analisar ativamente as tendências do mercado global para enfrentar desafios de forma eficiente e aproveitar oportunidades.
  • Manter margens de preço para atingir as metas de rentabilidade.
  • Garantir o mix de produtos com base em receita, volume e margens.
  • Garantir o mix de clientes com base no tipo de stakeholder, proporção de contribuição de receita e fatores de dependência.
  • Atingir metas de receita visando crescimento ideal ano a ano.
  • Monitorar o desempenho de pagamentos na carteira de clientes.
  • Desenvolver planos de aquisição e retenção de clientes para maximizar o valor do ciclo de vida do cliente (CLV).
  • Acompanhar a entrega de serviços técnicos dos produtos em toda a carteira de clientes.
  • Participar de programas de treinamento para equipes globais com base em análise de gaps de competências.
  • Realizar reportes periódicos de vendas e apresentações junto ao vice-presidente.
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas e proposição de ações em coordenação com o vice-presidente.
  • Trabalhar em outros projetos comerciais adicionais conforme designado.

Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado ou fluente
  • Graduação em química, engenharia química ou áreas correlatas
  • Vivência na indústria química.

title: Mobile Engineer
description:
Location: San Francisco, CA - Remote (LATAM preferred)

Work Type: Full-Time


We’re partnering with a confidential, high-growth technology company in Silicon Valley that’s building AI-powered platforms. This team moves fast, cares about craftsmanship, and empowers engineers to own meaningful work for the long term.


This is a full-time, remote opportunity to join a global-first product team tackling complex problems with modern tech and a culture that values quality and speed.


✅ What You’ll Do

- Design, build, and maintain features across the stack.

- Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering peers to ship high-quality work.

- Write clean, well-tested, well-documented code.

- Contribute to architecture decisions, technical planning, and code reviews.

- Help shape team workflows, best practices, and developer experience.


What You Bring

- 5+ years of professional experience in software development as a Full Stack Developer.

- 2+ years of professional experience as an AI/ML Engineer.

- Proficiency with Python, React, Express, MongoDB, Node or equivalent .

- Strong understanding of APIs, performance, scalability, etc..

- Clear, proactive communication and comfort working on distributed, async teams.

- A product mindset and strong sense of ownership.

- Startup or high-growth team background

- Proficiency in English

- Passion for building scalable systems and great user experiences.


What You’ll Get

- Competitive compensation in USD.

- 100% remote with flexible hours.

- Long-term, product-focused work with clear ownership.

- A smart, collaborative, globally distributed team.


If you’re excited to work with a fast-moving team building the future of AI at scale — let’s connect.

title: \"Analista de suporte Ecommerce Pleno #993094\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

  • Atuar no suporte a incidentes envolvendo VTEX, Hub de Integração e ERP.
  • Realizar triagem e análise funcional/técnica inicial antes do escalonamento para Produto ou Desenvolvimento.
  • Abrir, acompanhar e encerrar tickets técnicos junto a fornecedores (VTEX, integrações, etc.), garantindo contexto, evidências e retorno aos solicitantes.
  • Analisar e interpretar logs, APIs e fluxos de integração, identificando falhas de processo, cadastro ou sistema.
  • Validar jornadas do usuário no front-end, identificando quebras, impactos no negócio e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Monitorar de forma proativa processos críticos do e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, impostos e cadastros).
  • Garantir o cumprimento de SLAs de plataformas e parceiros.
  • Atuar como ponto focal de comunicação, evitando alinhamentos paralelos e respeitando os fluxos definidos.
  • Registrar recorrências e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos operacionais do e-commerce.
  • Apoiar a padronização de atendimentos, fluxos e documentação, contribuindo para a maturidade do suporte.


Experiência :

  • Conhecimento em VTEX (IO / FastStore).
  • Experiência com Hub de Integrações.
  • Capacidade de interpretação de logs e APIs REST (JSON, HTTP).
  • Noções de ITIL e processos de suporte.
  • Entendimento dos fluxos de e-commerce B2B (preço, estoque, pedidos, cadastros e cálculo de impostos).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de chamados e acompanhamento de SLA.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e organização para lidar com múltiplas demandas.


Valorizamos a diversidade e incentivamos a candidatura de profissionais de todos os perfis. Esta vaga é aberta a pessoas de diferentes gêneros, raças, orientações, idades, pessoas com deficiência e demais grupos.

title: Desenvolvedor Java/ Springboot - Sênior
description:
Pessoa desenvolvedora Backend Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e serviços backend de alta qualidade e eficiência, utilizando Java e SpringBoot.
  • Colaborar com times de frontend e outros stakeholders para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos de negócio e técnicos.
  • Documentar as soluções e práticas adotadas no desenvolvimento.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java.
  • Conhecimento do framework SpringBoot e suas principais bibliotecas e módulos (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring MVC, etc).
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL) e noSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência com controle de versão, preferencialmente Git.



Você pode se destacar se:

  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD (ex: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e em servidores de aplicação leve.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer

title: Junior SMM Manager
description:
We are looking for a Junior SMM Manager to support the growth of the SPLAT brand in Brazil.

This role is designed for someone with basic hands-on experience in social media who is ready to take ownership of content, actively engage with audiences, and grow quickly in a fast-paced international environment.

You will work closely with the team to build brand presence, test content ideas, and improve engagement in the local market.


What You Will Do

Content Creation (core focus):

  • Create and publish content across social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, etc.)
  • Write captions and adapt content for the Brazilian audience
  • Use simple tools (Canva, CapCut, etc.) to produce content

Community Management:

  • Manage comments and direct messages
  • Engage with followers and maintain a consistent brand tone

Influencer Outreach (basic level):

  • Identify and research local micro-influencers
  • Support communication and collaboration processes

Growth & Insights:

  • Monitor trends and competitors
  • Suggest practical ideas to improve reach and engagement


Who We Are Looking For

  • Fluent in English (daily communication with an international team)
  • Native or fluent in Brazilian Portuguese
  • Based in Brazil (São Paulo preferred)
  • Has basic SMM experience (personal projects, freelance, or internships)
  • Understands how modern social media works
  • Can create simple content independently
  • Proactive, reliable, and comfortable with routine execution
  • Motivated to learn and grow in marketing


Application Requirements

  • Please include: links to social media accounts you have managed or examples of content you have created

Applications without examples may not be considered.


What We Offer

  • Hands-on SMM experience from day one
  • Clear tasks and real responsibility (no “theory-only” role)
  • International team and English-speaking environment
  • Fast growth for strong performers

title: Graphic Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yeah, you heard that right.


Dingus & Zazzy is looking for a motivated, ambitious Graphic Designer to join our growing team!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Key Responsibilities


  • Create visually appealing designs for various platforms, including digital, print, social media, and branding.
  • Use AI tools and design software to streamline the design process, generate ideas, and automate repetitive tasks, ensuring fresh and innovative results.
  • Use AI tools (Nanobanana, Freepik AI, Magic Canva Studio) to generate engaging videos and simple animations for social media.
  • Editing videos and creating simple animations for social media use.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (marketing, content, etc.) to deliver high-quality design solutions that align with brand guidelines and project goals.
  • Work on design projects from start to finish, ensuring designs are on-brand, on-time, and meet all requirements.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and AI technologies to keep your work innovative and relevant.
  • Edit and optimize designs for various media, ensuring the best quality and user experience across devices.


Qualifications


  • Strong experience as a graphic designer, with a portfolio showcasing your skills in visual design, creativity, and problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in design software like Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, Premiere), Canva, Figma, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft programs (PowerPoint and Word)
  • Experience working with video editing tools like Premiere, CapCut, and Canva.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered design tools (such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Nanobanana, Midjourney, Firefly, Freepik AI, Claude, etc.) and an eagerness to explore new AI technologies.
  • Understanding of digital design principles for social media, websites, and other online platforms.
  • Understanding of small-scale and large-scale print materials (such as business cards, flyers, menus, conference collateral, merchandise, banners, backdrops, etc.)
  • Ability to work efficiently, meet deadlines, and manage multiple design projects simultaneously.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team members.
  • A working level of written and spoken English


Our operating hours are 9 A.M. to 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday.


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

description:

Modalidade PJ

Modelo: Remoto Full

Projeto: Sustentação


Descrição Detalhada:

- Um líder técnico e visionário que definirá a estratégia e a arquitetura de todo o sistema de IA.

- Liderança Técnica: Habilidade de liderar e mentorar equipes, traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções técnicas de IA.

title: OPERADOR DE CALDEIRA
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nossos objetivos.


Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.


Descrição Breve do Cargo :

Operar caldeiras, efetuar a dosagem de produtos químicos nas caldeiras, monitorar o descarregamento de BPF de carretas para tanques, realizar manobras de descarregamento de óleo diesel, operar estação de tratamento de agua, realizar a movimentação de insumos para a Refinaria, operar plantas de branqueamento e desodorização, executar suas atividades conforme rotinas operacionais, atuar, sempre que necessário, nas áreas de carregamento e formulação e na Estação de Tratamento de Efluentes, executar outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação superior.



Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo.
  • Segurança na Operação de Vasos de Pressão - NR 13.
  • Flexibilidade de aprendizagem.
  • Experiência como operador de Caldeira ou de Produção.
  • Interesse em aprender sobre processos industriais.
  • Informática básica/intermediária.


Nossa Empresa

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse:


#VemSerAgropalma

title: Desenvolvedor(a) SAP BTP CAP
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


A transformação digital ajuda as empresas a atingirem seu potencial máximo - se as tecnologias funcionarem para as pessoas que as utilizam! A NTT DATA Business Solutions está há 30 anos no mercado mundial. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por transformação. E queremos transformar o mundo e as pessoas através das soluções que criamos juntos com nossos parceiros. Aqui projetamos, implementamos, gerenciamos e potencializamos continuamente as soluções SAP para fazê-las funcionar para as empresas – e para as pessoas.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Buscamos um(a) profissional SAP FullStack (Pleno ou Sênior) para atuar em ambientes SAP S/4HANA, com foco em desenvolvimento moderno utilizando o modelo RAP e aplicações Fiori. A posição envolve atuação ponta a ponta, desde a camada de dados e serviços até a interface, colaborando com arquitetos e consultores funcionais em times ágeis ou híbridos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver soluções SAP FullStack no ambiente S/4HANA.
  • Implementar serviços utilizando o modelo RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Criar e manter CDS Views (projection, exposure e behavior) e Behavior Definitions.
  • Desenvolver Service Definitions e Service Bindings com exposição via OData V4.
  • Construir aplicações com Fiori Elements.
  • Atuar com ABAP OO seguindo boas práticas de Clean Code e qualidade de código.
  • Realizar revisões de código e aplicar padrões de qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com arquitetos, consultores funcionais e times ágeis.


Requisitos:


  • Experiência prática com SAP S/4HANA.
  • Domínio do modelo RAP.
  • Conhecimento sólido em ABAP Orientado a Objetos.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuação em times ágeis ou híbridos.
  • Mentalidade orientada a Clean Code, qualidade e manutenção evolutiva.


Diferenciais (Desejável):


  • Participação em pelo menos uma implementação greenfield de SAP S/4HANA.
  • Experiência com ATC, SCI ou outras ferramentas de qualidade de código.
  • Certificações SAP.
  • Inglês intermediário/ avançado.


Regime de contratação: CLT

100% Remoto no Brasil

Viagens pontoais (2-3 vezes ao ano)


Liberte todo o seu potencial e engenhosidade – molde o seu próprio futuro. Somos mais do que apenas um local de trabalho; somos uma incubadora de talentos. Com diversos caminhos e oportunidades de aprendizado e carreira de longo prazo, oferecemos inúmeras maneiras de realizar seus sonhos.


*Todas as vagas da NTT DATA são destinadas também para pessoas com deficiência.

title: Sr. Procurement Analyst -80% Spanish
description:
About the Job


Sr. Procurement Analyst will execute and manage Indirect spend categories' strategic sourcing and procurement across all supply chain operations facility types agreed to be in-scope and will deliver business requirements providing the best value to key business stakeholders.The focus will be managing the end-to-end strategic sourcing process and all in-scope elements of indirect spend for LATAM with emphasis on Brazil and the rest of the countries of South America (not limited).


Scope: Regions: Americas (subregion: LATAM)


Languages : Portuguese and Spanish 90%


Key Responsibilities May Include:


  • Develop and execute category strategies aligned with regional and global procurement priorities, leveraging market analysis to optimize supplier selection and performance.
  • Lead end-to-end sourcing activities, including negotiating contracts, managing supplier relationships, and ensuring compliance with company policies and legal requirements.
  • Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities within assigned categories to meet annual savings targets and drive value for the business.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to align procurement activities with business needs and ensure early involvement in the sourcing process.
  • Monitor supplier performance against key performance indicators (KPIs) and address gaps to improve quality, delivery, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure procurement activities adhere to governance, ethical sourcing practices, and sustainability objectives while supporting audit and compliance requirements.
  • Provide regular reporting and analytics on procurement performance, including spend analysis, cost savings, and supplier performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global category managers and cross-functional teams to leverage scale, align strategies, and drive procurement initiatives effectively.



Experience- What you will bring


  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred (Business, Supply Chain, or Engineering).
  • Operations support experience.
  • 4+ years of procurement experience supporting business operations with YoY savings.
  • Strong supplier segmentation, supplier performance and relationship management
  • experience
  • Experience in business operations, or supporting operations, at a large
  • multinational company.
  • Strategic Sourcing knowledge and experience (7-Step Process).

title: Senior Applied Scientist (AI/ML - Inbound Team)
description:
Senior Applied Scientist – AI/ML Customer Science (Remote – Brazil)


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Employment Type: PJ – Long term


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced machine learning, causal inference, and optimization systems that drive Marketing and Sales decision-making.

In this role, you will transform complex customer behavior and business growth challenges into measurable objectives and scalable ML solutions across acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue optimization.

You will work at the intersection of machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and business strategy in a fast-paced, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment.


What You’ll Work On

You will build models and platforms that create impact across areas such as:

  • Sales prioritization and expected value modeling
  • Marketing targeting and uplift modeling
  • Multi-touch attribution and incrementality measurement
  • Customer lifecycle modeling (conversion, retention, churn, LTV)
  • Outreach optimization and personalization systems


Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop machine learning, statistical, and causal models for Marketing and Sales use cases including:
  • Propensity and expected value modeling
  • Uplift and treatment effect estimation
  • Attribution and marketing measurement
  • Forecasting, optimization, and prioritization systems
  • Translate business growth problems into clear objectives, loss functions, and evaluation frameworks
  • Design feature representations capturing customer behavior, engagement, and lifecycle dynamics
  • Design and analyze experiments (A/B tests, geo tests, incrementality tests, diff-in-diff, causal impact)
  • Build and maintain robust evaluation frameworks aligned with business outcomes (ROI, CAC, conversion, retention, LTV)
  • Own the end-to-end ML lifecycle: data ingestion, feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring
  • Develop scalable ML services integrated into business workflows (CRM, marketing platforms, internal tools)
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Data teams
  • Influence technical direction and roadmap prioritization based on business impact
  • Clearly communicate insights and model behavior to technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers and help establish best practices
  • Contribute to long-term data science strategy, platforms, and innovation


Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of industry experience in applied Machine Learning
  • Master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • 3+ years of experience building, deploying, and managing ML models in production at scale
  • Strong knowledge of ML best practices (feature engineering, experimentation, pipelines, model evaluation)
  • Experience with modern ML techniques including gradient boosting, deep learning, transformers, and optimization
  • Experience in Computer Vision (Causal Inference experience is a strong plus)
  • Proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Hands-on experience with ML frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Scikit-learn
  • Strong data engineering skills with large-scale datasets
  • Experience with big data tools such as Apache Beam, Kafka, Spark
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)


Preferred Qualifications

  • PhD in CS, ML, AI, Statistics, Operations Research, or related field
  • Experience applying ML in retail or commercial business contexts
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools and production pipelines
  • Strong leadership and mentoring experience
  • Impact-driven mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality, scalable solutions

title: QA Engineer
description:
Senior QA Engineer

Location: Remote (Brazil. Based)

Reports to: QA Engineer Senior

Type: Full-time

Salary : Competitive open to negotiate payment USD

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to join our growing technology team for an important Fintech Crypto Company. This role is crucial in ensuring the quality, performance, and reliability of our software products.

You will be responsible for executing manual and automated tests, identifying and documenting issues, and creating test scenarios aligned with business and technical requirements. You’ll also contribute to improving QA processes, CI/CD integration, and leveraging AI technologies to enhance automation efficiency and coverage.

This is a hands-on position — ideal for someone who enjoys both technical testing and process improvement , and who thrives in a collaborative, Agile environment.

⚙️ Key Responsibilities

  • Execute manual and automated tests to ensure software quality and performance.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases based on business requirements.
  • Create and manage functional and regression tests across multiple platforms.
  • Identify, document, and track issues and inconsistencies; collaborate with developers for timely resolution.
  • Support and promote best quality assurance practices within the development team.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to support continuous delivery.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve QA processes, tools, and methodologies .
  • Provide clear reporting on testing progress, risks, and software quality metrics.
  • Utilize AI-based tools to enhance test creation, automation scripting, and defect detection.
  • Collaborate closely with product owners, developers, and stakeholders to ensure alignment with user expectations.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Experience

  • 4+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, with 2+ years in automation testing.
  • Proven experience in manual and automated testing within an Agile environment.
  • Strong background in designing and executing detailed test plans and defect management .
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows .

Technical Skills

  • Advanced English level (C1 ).
  • Proficiency with testing frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, or Playwright .
  • Familiarity with AI tools for generating or optimizing test scripts.
  • Experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).
  • Understanding of REST APIs, SQL , and general software testing methodologies.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum practices and ability to collaborate in iterative development cycles.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright .
  • Exposure to AI-based test automation or intelligent test generation tools.
  • Experience with cloud-based environments and microservices testing.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools .

Why Join Us

  • Work with cutting-edge QA and AI technologies in a fast-paced environment.
  • Join a collaborative, innovation-driven engineering culture .
  • Competitive compensation and long-term growth opportunities .
  • Opportunity to contribute to high-impact, scalable software solutions .

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Lead Data Engineer

Brazil- Remote

Long Term Contract



Job Description:


  • Proven experience in designing and implementing data solutions on the Databricks platform.
  • Solid understanding of Databricks fundamentals/architecture and have hands on experience in setting up Databricks cluster, working in Databricks modules (Data Engineering, ML and SQL warehouse).
  • Create and maintain documentation for data pipelines, processes, and best practices.
  • Knowledge of Performance Optimization, Monitoring and Automation would be a plus.
  • Understanding of data governance, compliance, and security best practices.
  • Knowledge in anyone of the cloud platforms AWS is a must.
  • Strong Proficiency in Pyspark, Databricks Notebooks, SQL, Python, Scala, or Java.
  • Certifications in Databricks would be beneficial.
  • Strong understanding of data engineering best practices, data modeling, Data warehousing and ETL processes.
  • Staying up-to-date with the latest Databricks features and best practices.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data querying and manipulation.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills

title: AWS AI/ML Architect (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Projetar soluções utilizando serviços da AWS para IA generativa, como Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker.
  • Definir padrões de orquestração de agentes, integração com APIs e workflows corporativos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar AI Agents capazes de executar tarefas, consultas e automações complexas.
  • Construir pipelines de RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) para acesso a dados corporativos.
  • Integrar agentes com sistemas bancários, APIs internas e plataformas digitais.
  • Implementar memória de agentes, ferramentas (tools) e mecanismos de reasoning.
  • Aplicar AI Agents para acelerar desenvolvimento e modernização de aplicações.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de Smart Engineering e AI-assisted development.
  • Garantir aderência a requisitos de segurança, compliance e governança de dados do setor financeiro.
  • Definir modelos de observabilidade e métricas de performance para agentes de IA.
  • Monitorar qualidade de respostas, latência e custo de inferência.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência com Agents Builder / desenvolvimento de AI Agents
  • Experiência em Arquitetura Cloud (AWS)
  • Experiência com Amazon Bedrock e Amazon SageMaker
  • Domínio em RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
  • conhecimento em MLOps
  • conhecimento em Spring Boot / Java
  • Integração com APIs REST
  • Orquestração de agentes e workflows
  • Implementação de memória, tools e reasoning em agentes de IA
  • Integração com sistemas corporativos e plataformas digitais
  • Observabilidade e monitoramento de IA (qualidade de resposta, latência e custo de inferência)

title: Remote Government Sector Expert - 65106
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role overview:

We are looking for public sector domain experts (5+ years experience) to create real-world, profession-based prompts and tasks. The role involves creating high quality prompts and documents to evaluate model responses on day-to-day work in government, policy, and social service domains


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create realistic, first-person prompts based on actual job workflows
  • Design tasks that reflect real-world public sector and policy scenarios
  • Select and use relevant public data/documents as input files
  • Ensure prompts are clear, specific, and aligned to the occupation
  • Review tasks for accuracy, completeness, and real-world relevance


Requirements:

  • Degree in Social Work, Public Administration, Management, or related field
  • Strong understanding of real-world workflows in your profession
  • Ability to convert work scenarios into structured, high-quality prompts


Who can Apply :

We are open to many experts within the public sector (including but not limited to): Child, Family, and School Social Workers, First-Line Supervisors of Police and Detectives, Recreation Workers, Compliance Officers, Administrative Services Managers.


Terms of Contract :

  • Opportunity is for a project that is ~2 week duration with potential extension


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

description:
Como trabalhar na Grant Thornton?

Aqui o aprendizado e o desenvolvimento são constantes. E o nosso espírito colaborativo faz toda a diferença para o seu crescimento individual e conquistas em equipe.

Nossos tempos são formados por pessoas e talentos, com trajetórias, habilidades únicas. Inovação que diversidade é essencial para o fortalecimento da nossa organização e dos nossos colaboradores, refletindo em melhores, promovendo e continuados para nossos clientes.

title: Analista Pleno de IAM
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista Pleno de IAM (gestão de identidade e acesso)



Resumo:

Estamos buscando um Analista Pleno de IAM experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe de cibersegurança. Este profissional será responsável por criar processos, configurar ferramentas e aprimorar os assuntos de IAM de forma global.

O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outras frentes de segurança, infraestrutura, sistemas e equipes de negócios, avaliando as melhorias e implementações necessárias para a eficácia do Programa de IAM.



Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter processos de gestão de identidades e acessos, incluindo provisionamento, revogação e revisão periódica de privilégios;
  • Administrar e implementar ferramentas relacionadas à IAM garantindo funcionamento, confiabilidade e atendendo aos requisitos de segurança;
  • Criar, revisar e otimizar regras, perfis, grupos e políticas de acesso, assegurando a aplicação de princípio de privilégio mínimo e SoD (Segregação de Funções), para ambientes on prem e cloud;
  • Auxiliar na estratégia para integração de sistemas e aplicações às plataformas de IAM;
  • Colaborar com outros times para mapear processos de acesso, identificar riscos e sugerir implementações ou automações de controles;
  • Apoiar times internos na compreensão das práticas de gestão de identidades, acessos e requisitos de segurança relacionados;
  • Suportar processos de auditorias.



Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência:

  • Experiência de ao menos 3 anos atuando diretamente com temas ligados à IAM;
  • Formação Superior em Tecnologia da Informação/Segurança da Informação;
  • Conhecimento em temas como AD/Entra ID, LDAP, SAML, Oauth, SSO, MFA, PAM, SoD, RBAC, princípio de menor privilégio e revisão de acessos;
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Defender for Identity, e demais ferramentas de IAM para ambientes híbridos e multicloud (On Prem, Azure, AWS, GCP);
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento em normas e boas práticas de segurança da informação (ex: ISO 27001, NIST, etc).



Requisitos desejáveis:


  • Certificações relevantes de fabricantes de soluções para IAM/PAM, exemplo:

(CyberArk, Senha Segura, BeyondTrust, SailPoint, Okta, Microsoft EntraID, etc).




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Engenheiro Orçamentista
description:
Atividades:

Desenvolvimento e estudo das diversas etapas para a elaboração de Propostas Técnicas e Comerciais para clientes de Infraestrutura, assim como apoio às obras em andamento:


Leitura análise dos projetos;

Consultas ao mercado de fornecedores;

Planejamento das obras em estudo;

Orçamento do custo direto em softwares da área;

Desenvolvimento do custo indireto

Análise das condições de fechamento e impostos.

Elaboração de Planejamento de Obra.


Outros requisitos


Ter experiência como Engenheiro Orçamentista em obra de construção pesada, principalmente obras de infraestrutura na área mineração (barragem, diques, etc), rodoviárias, ferroviárias, e Obras de arte correntes, pontes e viadutos.

Conhecimento em Softwares de Orçamentos (Compor 90, RM, etc) e Planejamento de Obras (Project, Primavera e afins);

Superior completo em Engenharia Civil ou Produção.

Pós-graduação na área de Engenharia de Custos (desejável);

title: Partner Success Executive - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Partner Success Executive position focuses on managing relationships with Senior Advisors - senior referral partners committed to generating leads through introductions. This role involves ensuring advisors achieve their lead goals through effective time management, process execution, and relationship building while maintaining engagement cadence, tracking performance metrics, and optimizing targeting strategies to drive high-quality introductions and conversions.


Key responsibilities


- Onboarding new Senior Advisors by establishing clear expectations around introductions, engagement cadence, and performance metrics.

- Providing ongoing support to advisors as the primary point of contact, maintaining structured 1:1 meetings to track pipeline and engagement, guiding targeting strategy and ideal prospect profiles, and monitoring performance metrics.

- Managing introductions and lead generation by qualifying prospects before engagement, connecting with introduced prospects in a timely and professional manner, managing follow-up cadence through conversion or disqualification, and handing off qualified leads to Sales Operations with proper documentation.

- Driving advisor engagement by maintaining motivation and retention, facilitating participation in advisory tasks, events, and networking initiatives, collecting structured feedback to improve program design, and ensuring positive experience and long-term program loyalty.

- Providing feedback to advisors on introduction quality and outcomes while optimizing targeting based on conversion data.

- Driving continuous improvement by proposing process enhancements where applicable.


Requirements


- Account Management Experience: 4+ years of relevant experience in Account Management or Business Development roles in similar environments.

- US Market Knowledge: 1+ year of experience working with the US market in sales, business development, or account management capacity.

- Energy and Motivation: High energy levels and self-driven motivation to achieve results.

- People Skills: Excellent interpersonal abilities and relationship-building capabilities.

- Communication Excellence: Strong selling, communication, and negotiation skills.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!
